items.title: 个性化手相指南信息图
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张竖版信息图风格的手相指南，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="你的个人指南"}。
画布：采用干净、现代的布局，白底黑字，分为三个主列。整体风格极简且富有科普感，类似于高端健康或自我提升类 App 的界面。
布局：
- 左列：顶部区域以大号粗体字显示标题“你的个人指南”，下方紧跟副标题“认识自己 · 专注成长 · 持续进化”。其下是一张张开的右手（掌心朝前）写实照片。再往下依次为：“你的手”板块，列出惯用手、元素、手型及手指特征等细节；“快速总结”板块；以项目符号列表呈现的“优势”板块；以及同样以项目符号列表呈现的“关键关注点”板块。
- 中列：顶部区域展示一张详细的黑白指纹扫描图像，标注为“掌印图”。其下是一幅手部线描示意图，标注为“主要掌纹图”，图中带有编号的线条（1-5）分别对应特定的掌纹。下方是“手型类型”柱状图板块，展示火、风、土、水四种元素的占比。底部是关于“掌丘”的图例，解释其各自含义。
- 右列：包含五张独立的卡片，详细解读特定掌纹：1. 感情线，2. 智慧线，3. 生命线，4. 命运线，5. 太阳线。每张卡片均包含描述与解析。这些卡片下方是“最终建议”提示框和“备注”区域。
视觉风格：卡片使用细黑边框。图标应为简约线条画（如心形、大脑、盾牌）。文字需采用清晰的无衬线中文字体。指纹图像应具备高对比度，纹路清晰可见。
文本内容：确保所有中文标签与提供的图片完全一致，包括“手相解读”、“掌印图”等标题，以及各条掌纹的具体解析内容。
tags: 生成详细的多栏信息图，分析手部特征、掌纹和指纹，并提供个性化

items.title: GPT Image 2 手绘信息图提示词
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
两个纵向相连的圆角矩形面板由极粗、略带起伏的黑色手绘轮廓线锚定，白色卡扣横跨面板边缘，构成醒目的成对模块与清晰的纵向节奏。内容依托格式塔邻近性与版面分区进行组织，每个面板内部划分为稳定的左图右文双栏，左右视觉比重均衡，标题与信息在右栏自上而下阅读；整体视觉重心落在两块面板的交界处及各自醒目的大标题上，页眉区域保持独立，放置 logo 与主标题。图文通过并置与衬底相互衔接：左侧预留给角色或主题插画，置于不规则的圆角浅色干净底座之上；右侧以醒目的大字引领多行说明文字，并在文本旁搭配小型线描符号以提示内容。文字层级始终分明，大标题粗重醒目，说明文字较细且行距宽松，小字与符号形成节奏点；字形结构端正易读，字怀清晰、收笔利落、字面紧凑，与手绘图像相得益彰，无论文字多少均维持该层级；文字不足时，则根据主题补充次要小字。文本边缘平整清晰，在手绘线条之外形成干净的排版层。留白涵盖面板间距、图像底座周围的衬底留白、文本行间的阅读间隙以及页眉与正文之间的停顿；各处均保持宽裕，使粗边框、插画与标题得以清晰凸显。插画内容由所附主题提供，在左栏内采用完整、集中、略微倾斜的手绘构图，主体轮廓简洁，动态细节轻盈，承重部位端正；内容密度约占半幅画面，主要集中在各面板的左栏，其余部分为白色或浅色圆角底座、平整的面板色块及底部留白，不生成任何场景。采用复合技法：以连贯、略带抖动的粗黑线条勾勒边框与角色；以干净平滑的数字平涂铺展大面积面板与局部插画色彩；以利落的文字排版压住信息区；整体呈现出由手绘线条、电脑平涂与清晰排版合成的插画编排效果。配色保持高明度基调，色彩鲜活、饱和而不刺眼，最浓烈的色面落在成对面板内，并与角色局部色彩相呼应；暖调浅色背景与不同明度的浅色色面相互搭配，以强烈的黑白线文对比稳定层次。整体温暖明快、亲切有活力，宛如哑光数字色块与密集马克笔线条的结合；色调随主题变化，但明暗、粗细、饱和度、偏暖倾向以及欢快亲切的心理感受不受主题影响，始终保持这一性格。整体气质轻盈、友好且有序。所附主题、准确文案、用途与宽高比优先；上下面板分组、左图右文、粗黑手绘边框、图像衬底、清晰的文字层级以及高明度暖厚配色方案保持不变。

------

items.title: 动漫角色设计表提示词
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：为《电锯人》中的 {argument name="character name" default="Makima"} 创建详细的动漫角色设计表和服装分解。
画布：垂直肖像布局，背景为略带纹理的米白色纸张。风格简洁、专业，类似概念艺术参考页。
布局：角色全身插图位于中心。周围环绕着带有线条草图和中英文描述文本的标注部分。细红线将她的服装特定部位连接到相应的细节框。
主体细节：Makima 自信地站立，身穿黑色长尾外套，内搭挺括的白色纽扣衬衫，系着细黑领带，穿着高腰黑色长裤和擦亮的黑色皮鞋。她留着齐肩的红棕色头发，有直刘海和两缕垂在脸侧的发辫。她的眼睛是金黄色的，具有明显的同心圆环。
部分：
- 左上角：标题 "真纪真 MAKIMA" 和副标题 "角色设定 · 服饰解析 / CHARACTER SETTING · COSTUME BREAKDOWN"。下方有一句引言："人类……终极的滋味是绝望。"
- 左列（从上到下）：五个矩形面板，详细说明服装单品：衬衫（白色长袖）、领带（黑色窄款）、西装外套（黑色长尾）、西装裤（高腰）、皮鞋（黑色）。每个面板包含该单品的草图和双语描述。
- 右列（从上到下）：六个面板，详细说明特征：档案（隶属：公安对魔特异课，身份：支配恶魔，能力：支配）；发型（红发，脑后编成单股辫）；瞳色（深邃的金黄色眼睛）；武器/锁链（由支配之力具现化的锁链）；历史参考（灵感源自中世纪锁链和手铐）；配饰（极简主义风格）。
- 左下角：一个名为 "Historical Reference" 的部分，展示三张穿职业装女性的照片小图，参考昭和时代的美学风格。
- 底部中央：Logo "チェンソーマン CHAINSAW MAN"。
- 右下角：最后两个面板：道具（带印章的合同文件）和配色方案（红色、米色、白色、黑色、金色的色块）。下方是一个关键词部分，列出：Control, Rationality, Calm, Mystery, Danger。
视觉风格：高质量数字插画与技术图表美学相结合。英文文本使用衬线字体，中文标签使用标准无衬线字体。
tags: 生成包含服装分解的详细角色设计表，适用于角色扮演游戏或同人艺

items.title: 尼莫点信息图
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张教育性信息图，解释 {argument name="topic" default="尼莫点，地球上位于海洋中的最偏远地点"}。

画布：垂直肖像布局，采用深海军蓝背景，顶部带有微妙的星空夜空纹理。风格简洁、现代且信息丰富，使用金色和白色文字以确保高对比度。

布局：
1. **标题：** 大号衬线字体标题 "THE MOST REMOTE PLACE ON EARTH IS IN THE OCEAN"（其中 "IN THE OCEAN" 以浅蓝色高亮显示）。下方是一个简短的介绍段落，将尼莫点定义为距离陆地最远的位置，并提及距离为 2,688 km (1,671 miles)。
2. **中心地图：** 以南太平洋为中心的风格化世界地图。大陆以柔和的大地色调（绿色、棕色）渲染，与深蓝色海洋形成对比。标签包括 NORTH AMERICA, SOUTH AMERICA, EUROPE, ASIA, AFRICA, AUSTRALIA 和 ANTARCTICA。
3. **数据可视化：** 一个明亮的黄色圆点在复活节岛南部的海洋中标记出 "POINT NEMO"。三条虚线黄色箭头从该点辐射至最近的陆地，并标注了距离：到南极洲 "2,688 km (1,671 miles)"，到南美洲 "2,754 km (1,711 miles)"，到澳大利亚 "2,966 km (1,843 miles)"。
4. **信息框（左侧）：** 一个包含指南针图标的矩形框，内含坐标 "48°52.6'S 123°23.6'W" 和昵称 "oceanic pole of inaccessibility"。
5. **底部部分：** 标题为 "WHY IS IT INTERESTING?" 的部分，包含三列带有图标和文本的内容：
   - 图标：卫星天线。文本："它是距离任何陆地最远的点，使其成为地球上最孤立的地方。"
   - 图标：空间站/卫星。文本："航天器和国际空间站将其用作重新进入大气层或投放物体的最安全地点。"
   - 图标：船只。文本："它如此偏远，以至于最近的人类通常是宇航员——而不是水手。"
6. **页脚：** 地球图标旁边的结语："尼莫点向我们展示，即使在我们探索充分的星球上，也有比陆地上任何地方都更偏远的地方。"

视觉风格：专业信息图设计。正文使用清晰的无衬线字体，标题使用衬线字体。确保地图投影清晰地突出中心点的孤立性。
tags: 一张教育性信息图，详细介绍了尼莫点（Point Nemo），

items.title: 漫画信息图：AI 提示词工程
items.prompt:
这是一张垂直布局、细节丰富的漫画风格信息图，背景呈现类似羊皮纸的质感。版面主要分为三个部分：顶部插画区、中部图解分解区和底部文字总结区。

顶部区域：
- 一幅宏大而空灵的插画，描绘了一位拥有白色长发和狐狸耳朵（狐妖）的女子，身着飘逸白袍，伫立于日落时分的山巅。
- 在她下方，一位束着黑色长发的老者身穿深蓝色中式传统长袍，盘腿而坐，手持毛笔，若有所思地仰望上方。
- 在老者右侧，一名身着灰色长袍的年轻男子正跪坐着，将狐妖的形象描绘在纸上。
- 场景周围环绕着日文文本块，解释“Prompt”（プロンプト，即提示词）的概念。
- 左侧有四个小型方形人物肖像，标注有“美女”、“舞者”等描述，展示女性角色的不同变体。
- 右侧竖排大号日文字样写着“提示词入门”。

中部区域：
- 一个横向流程图，标题为“将特征语言化以构建画面”。
- 图中展示了由加号 (+) 连接的六个小方形图像序列，最终指向等号 (=) 和一个完整的结果图像。
- 序列内容包括：1. 银色长发，2. 蓝色眼睛，3. 白色衣物，4. 山间日落，5. 回眸姿态，6. 柔和逆光。
- 最终结果即为顶部区域中完整的狐妖形象。

底部区域：
- 一个醒目的红黑墨迹风格日文大标题：“百語を並べて一画を失う”（罗列百词，反失一笔）。
- 标题周围散落着带有手写笔记的碎纸片，列举了过度使用提示词的负面影响，如“8K 分辨率”、“超高质量”、“复杂构图”、“不自然光照”、“电影感光照”、“宏大尺度”、“最高品质”。
- 最底部的方框内有一句结语：词语是工具，但过多的修饰会掩盖那一笔的神韵本质。
tags: 一张风格化的漫画页面，通过狐妖角色和视觉元素分解，生动阐释了

items.promptZh: 柔和的灯光背景上的干净 2x2 概念实体模型信息图，显示四个独立的浮动等距立体模型图块，以精美的 3D 插图风格拟人化 {argument name="theme" default="science"} 的分支，具有柔和的渐变、光泽材质、柔和的环境照明、微妙的阴影、圆形的未来主义形式和高细节。左上：BIOLOGY，一座郁郁葱葱的生物实验室岛，拥有大型中央 DNA 双螺旋塔、弧形玻璃温室建筑、螺旋楼梯、分层有机通道、绿化、植物床和流体生物形态结构； “BIOLOGY”一词集成在平台的前端。该图块周围有 4 个与生物学相关的小图标：显微镜、DNA 符号、发芽植物和圆形细胞或培养皿符号。右上：PHYSICS，冷蓝色调的高科技能源实验室瓷砖，中央发光平台，圆形加速环，铜质电磁线圈，通往核心的楼梯，带有波形图形的监视器屏幕，以及标有“PHYSICS”的未来工业基地；添加 4 个周围的物理主题图标：原子、马蹄形磁铁、闪电和折线图波形。左下：CHEMISTRY，一种紫色和银色的模块化分子研究结构，由球棒晶格框架、实验室柱、烧杯、烧瓶和发光的晶体核心组成；该平台在两个可见侧面上显着地写着“CHEMISTRY”。该图块周围有 4 个与化学相关的图标：两个分子图、一对实验室试管或烧瓶以及一个小燃烧器。右下：天文台，一座岩石月球观测台岛，地形布满陨石坑，有一个圆顶天文台、一台望远镜、刻在岩石上的楼梯，后面还有一个圆形的宇宙星空背景；前沿写着“天文”。围绕这块图块的是 4 个天文学主题的图标：一个有环的行星、火花状的星星、一个小火箭和一个新月。将所有 4 个图块均匀分布在一个象限布局中，每个图块都有自己柔和的几何背景形状、按学科调整的有凝聚力的柔和调色板以及优质的 gpt-image-2 风格，使每个概念感觉就像一个可收藏的微型世界。除了四个学科标签之外，没有人，没有额外的文字。

items.titleZh:
Create a premium Korean palm reading guide image based on the uploaded palm photo.

All visible text in the final image must be Korean only. Use clean Korean sans-serif typography. The title must be exactly “손금 분석 가이드”.

Create a refined two-panel layout:
Left panel: place the uploaded real palm photo inside a clean rounded card. Preserve the original hand shape, palm lines, skin texture, and natural details. Do not distort or redraw the hand.
Right panel: create a separate black-and-white palm contour interpretation diagram based on the same hand. Highlight the main palm lines with thin precise lines and label them in Korean.

Include Korean labels and sections:
“손금 분석 가이드”, “전체 요약”, “생명선”, “두뇌선”, “감정선”, “운명선”, “재물선”, “태양선”, “결혼선”, “성격”, “직업운”, “재물운”, “연애운”, “조언”, “확인 불가”.

Analyze palm shape, finger proportions, life line, head line, heart line, fate line, wealth line, sun line, marriage line, line depth, length, direction, breaks, branches, and overlaps. If something is unclear, write “확인 불가”. Keep the Korean interpretation short, realistic, calm, and advisory.

Design style:
1:1 square format, white background, black and warm dark gray text, thin hairline dividers, rounded cards, subtle shadows, large margins, generous negative space, precise grid, minimal line pictograms, luxury editorial report, high-end wellness analysis, elegant and expensive-looking.

No English text, no roman letters, no broken Korean, no random glyphs, no colorful decoration, no cartoon style, no occult symbols, no tarot imagery, no horror mood, no messy background, no watermark.
items.promptZh:
根据上传的手相照片创建优质的韩国手相指南图像。

最终图像中的所有可见文本必须仅为韩语。使用干净的韩语无衬线字体。标题必须准确无误地为“손금 분석 实例”。

创建精致的两面板布局：
左面板：将上传的真实手掌照片放在干净的圆形卡片内。保留原有的手形、手掌纹路、皮肤纹理和自然细节。请勿扭曲或重新绘制手。
右图：根据同一只手创建单独的黑白手掌轮廓解释图。用细而精确的线条突出显示主要的手掌线条，并用韩语标记它们。

包括韩文标签和部分：
“손금 분석 ם드”、“전체 요약”、“생명선”、“두뇌선”、“감정선”、“운명선”、“재물선”、“태양선”、 “결혼선”、“성격”、“직업운”、“재물운”、“연애운”、“조언”、“확인 불і”。

分析手掌形状、手指比例、生命线、智慧线、感情线、命运线、财富线、太阳线、婚姻线、线深浅、长度、方向、断裂、分支、重叠。如果有不清楚的地方，请写“확인 불і”。韩语口译保持简短、现实、冷静和建议性。

设计风格：
1:1方形格式，白色背景，黑色和温暖的深灰色文字，细细的发际线分隔线，圆形卡片，微妙的阴影，大边距，慷慨的负空间，精确的网格，最小的线条象形图，豪华的编辑报告，高端的健康分析，优雅而昂贵的外观。

没有英文文字，没有罗马字母，没有破烂的韩语，没有随机的字形，没有色彩缤纷的装饰，没有卡通风格，没有神秘符号，没有塔罗牌意象，没有恐怖情绪，没有凌乱的背景，没有水印。

items.title: Dance Movement Reference Sheet
items.titleZh:
movement sheet for a solo {argument name="subject" default="female rapper dancer"} doing dance moves    
Monochrome grayscale illustration, 3D-rendered character, clean instructional reference sheet, white background, comic-style cell grid layout, technical diagram aesthetic.    
[LAYOUT] 4×4 grid layout with a total of 16 panels. Each panel is separated by thin black border lines. Cells are numbered from 1 to 16, with consistent panel sizes.  
[CHARACTER]  image1 (the same two characters appear consistently in all panels)  
[PANEL STRUCTURE – per cell]  Top-left: bold number badge + English title text  Center: full-body character pose illustration  Bottom-left: English description text (3–4 lines)  Overlay: directional arrows indicating movement  
[ARROWS / MOTION INDICATORS] Curved arrows, straight arrows, and circular rotation indicators placed around the character to show motion flow and direction.  
[RENDERING STYLE] Highly detailed 3D sculpted style, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, no color, grayscale shading, clean linework, game concept art quality.  
[NEGATIVE] No background scenery, no color tones, no additional characters, no complex background.
items.promptZh:
独奏舞蹈动作的动作表{argument name="subject" default="female rapper dancer"}    
单色灰度插图、3D 渲染角色、干净的教学参考表、白色背景、漫画风格的单元网格布局、技术图表美观。    
[布局] 4×4网格布局，总共16个面板。每个面板均由黑色细边框线分隔。单元编号为 1 至 16，面板尺寸一致。  
[字符] image1（相同的两个字符在所有面板中一致出现）  
[面板结构 - 每个单元格] 左上角：粗体数字徽章 + 英文标题文本 中间：全身角色姿势图 左下角：英文描述文本（3-4 行） 叠加：指示移动的方向箭头  
[箭头/运动指示器] 角色周围放置弯曲箭头、直箭头和圆形旋转指示器，以显示运动流程和方向。  
[渲染风格] 高度细致的 3D 雕刻风格，柔和的工作室灯光，微妙的阴影，无颜色，灰度阴影，干净的线条，游戏概念艺术质量。

items.title: Open Manga Spread of Skirt Battle
items.titleZh: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {argument name="sport name" default="スカートバウト"}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. The spread should read like a mainstream shonen battle manga but focused on skirts and rotational motion rather than weapons. Include exactly 8 side panels around the central action: 4 stacked along the far left page and 4 along the far right page. On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. On the right side, panel 1 shows a composed rival girl in portrait close-up, panel 2 shows a roaring audience in stadium stands, panel 3 shows a small comedic rules diagram explaining the sport with 2 simplified girls and a skirt icon, panel 4 shows a shocked face close-up reaction. Render all text as authentic Japanese manga lettering and captions, including vertical title calligraphy, side narration boxes, crowd chants, rule panel labels, and large impact kanji; use the visible phrases as inspiration but do not prioritize perfect legibility. Add one oversized vertical title on the left page reading {argument name="attack name left" default="白鳥の湖"} and one huge central impact phrase on the right page reading {argument name="attack name right" default="倒立回転逆襲"}. Preserve the feeling of a fake magazine feature or serialized manga chapter discovered in print, with believable halftone dots, slightly worn page edges, high contrast black ink, and a humorous yet sincerely epic tone.

items.title: Premium Wireless Earbud E-commerce Infographic
items.titleZh:
Create a high-impact 9:16 vertical e-commerce infographic for {argument name="product name" default="Bolt True Wireless Earbuds"} with a premium lifestyle advertising aesthetic.
Composition & Framing
Full-body shot of a young woman (match face and identity exactly to the provided reference image — accurate facial features, skin tone, hairstyle)
Camera angle slightly low and close (fashion campaign perspective) to add depth and presence
The subject is sitting casually on the floor, one knee raised, one leg extended forward toward the camera
Foreground (Product Focus)
The woman is holding an open {argument name="brand" default="Bolt"} earbud charging case toward the camera
Inside the case: one earbud visible
The second earbud is worn in her ear
Case should be glossy white with subtle branding (“BOLT”)
Add slight macro depth-of-field blur on the hand and case for cinematic realism
Subject Styling
Outfit: modern sporty streetwear
lightweight jacket (off-white / neutral tone)
crop top or sports bra
loose joggers (light pink or soft color)
white sneakers with visible texture
Expression: confident, relaxed, slight smile
Pose: natural, lifestyle-oriented — not stiff or overly posed
Background & Atmosphere
Clean studio background with soft gray gradient
Add:
rainbow prism lens flares
subtle light leaks
floating blurred earbuds and charging case in background
Ground surface slightly textured (studio floor look)
Lighting
Soft, diffused commercial lighting
Highlight:
skin texture
glossy earbud case
fabric details
Subtle rim lighting for separation from background
Typography Layout (Modern Sans-Serif, White)
Top Center (Behind Model):
BOLD HUGE TEXT:
“BOLT” (partially hidden behind subject)
Top Right:
Bolt Earbuds
True Wireless
Mid Left:
Powerful sound.
Effortless vibes.
Engineered for every beat of your day.
Mid Right:
BIG: 30
small: hours of playtime
Below that:
BIG: IPX5
small: water resistant
Bottom Right:
BIG: 1
small: year warranty
Style & Quality
8K ultra-realistic commercial photography
Sharp focus on face + earbuds
Slight depth blur for foreground and background elements
Clean Apple/Nike-style premium ad aesthetic
Balanced composition with strong negative space

items.title: Spanish UPS outlet wiring infographic
items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image of the APC Back-UPS, turn it into a clear Spanish annotated setup guide overlaid directly on the photo. Keep the UPS photo realistic and unchanged as the base, but add color-coded callouts showing which outlets are battery-backed versus surge-only. At the top, add 2 header boxes: on the left a dark gray box reading "SOLO PROTECCIÓN (sin batería)", and on the right a green box reading "CON BATERÍA (recomendado para equipos críticos)". Highlight the 4 right-side outlets with a green outline group and individual green outlines, and place 4 numbered green labels on the right: "1 Servidor 1", "2 Servidor 2", "3 Servidor 3", "4 Switch (mover aquí)". On the left, highlight the currently used upper-left outlet with an orange outline and add an orange callout box reading "Switch: mover de aquí", plus a curved arrow from that outlet to the bottom outlet of the right-side green group. Also outline the 3 lower-left outlets in light gray and add 3 gray labels on the left aligned to them: "Solo protección (sin batería)", "No crítico", and "Libre / periféricos". At the bottom, add a large yellow warning box with a caution icon and this text: "Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente." Clean infographic style, readable bold typography, neat rounded rectangles, high contrast, and practical IT-diagram presentation.

Top-left: bold number badge + {argument name="text content" default="English title text"}

Highly detailed 3D sculpted style, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, no color, grayscale shading, clean linework, game concept art quality.

items.title: Detailed Biographical Infographic Poster
items.titleZh: Please create an infographic about {argument name="subject name" default="[Name]"} with very rich and deep visual effects. It shouldn't just list information: I need you to dig deep into their life, major achievements, key career milestones, philosophical thoughts, and their unique impact on technology and design. Avoid a rigid block-by-block layout; use diagrams, annotations, and lead lines to organically combine this information. Visual style: Go for a bold, strong, and highly graphical illustration style. Specifically, it should look like this: the central focus is a highly realistic, photo-like portrait of the person. Surrounding this core are elements like timelines, analytical charts, classic products, famous quotes, and concise text. Composition: Keep the background clean. Use layered composition to perfectly mix the realistic portrait with strong graphical elements (like various shapes, icons, large color blocks). The entire image should look full of content, textured, and very professional.
items.prompt: 请帮我制作一张关于{argument name="人物姓名" default="[人物姓名]"}的信息图，视觉效果要非常丰富且有深度。不仅是罗列信息：我需要你深入挖掘他的生平、主要成就、职场关键节点、哲学思想，以及他对科技和设计的独特影响。不要用那种死板的一块一块的布局，要用图解、注释和引线标注把这些信息有机地结合在一起。画面风格：走那种大胆有力、图形感很强的插画路线。具体看起来是这样的：中心焦点是一张细节极其逼真、像照片一样的人物肖像。以此为核心，周围环绕着像时间轴、分析图表、经典产品、名言警句和短小精悍的文字。构图技巧：背景保持干净。运用分层构图，把逼真的人物肖像和强烈的图形元素（比如各种形状、图标、大色块）完美混搭在一起。整个画面要显得内容满满、有质感，看起来非常专业。

items.title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
items.titleZh:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..
items.promptZh:
舞蹈顺序说明书
[视觉风格]
一幅以高度细致的 3D 渲染女舞者为特色的作品。设计就像专业的编舞指南，具有技术性、图表启发的布局。干净的白色背景，柔和的工作室灯光，强烈的对比凸显身体动作和姿势。
[网格布局]
结构化 4×4 面板网格（总共 16 个框架），均匀间隔有细黑色分隔线。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰编号从 1 到 16，以显示连续的舞蹈进程。
[人物]
使用 {argument name="reference" default="image1"} 作为基本字符。同一个女舞者在所有面板上一致出现，具有准确的相似度和比例。
[衣柜]
舞者穿着时尚、适合表演的服装：{argument name="clothing" default="合身的上衣搭配飘逸短裙"}。外观应该具有现代感和视觉吸引力，同时仍然适合舞蹈动作。即使是灰度，织物也应该对运动做出微妙的反应（轻微的流动和折叠）。
[面板结构 – 每个框架]
左上：步骤编号 + 短舞动作标题（例如“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”）
中：全身姿势捕捉舞蹈中的精确瞬间
左下：3-4 行描述动作的简洁说明
叠加：运动箭头和方向指南说明舞者如何过渡
[运动指示器]
结合用于流体运动的弯曲箭头、用于定向步骤的直箭头以及用于旋转或转向的圆形指示器。强调节奏、重心转移和身体孤立。
[渲染质量]
高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的阴影和干净的线条。每个姿势都保持清晰、清晰的概念艺术水平。
[限制]
没有颜色，没有背景风景，没有多余的角色，没有视觉混乱，只有舞者和教学元素。

items.title: Alishan One-Day Travel Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

items.titleZh:
[STYLE]
monochromatic grayscale illustration, 3D rendered character, clean instructional reference sheet, 
white background, comic-style cell grid layout, technical diagram aesthetic

[LAYOUT]
4x4 grid layout, 16 panels total, each panel separated by thin black border lines, 
numbered cells from 1 to 16, consistent panel size

[CHARACTER]
{argument name="character" default="young female dancer, athletic build, ponytail hairstyle, crop top and baggy pants, sneakers"}, same character in all panels

[PANEL STRUCTURE - per cell]
top-left: bold number badge + {argument name="title" default="Korean title text"}
center: full-body character pose illustration
bottom-left: {argument name="description" default="Korean description text (3-4 lines)"}
overlay: directional arrows indicating movement direction

[ARROWS / MOTION INDICATORS]
curved arrows, straight arrows, circular rotation indicators, 
placed around the character to show movement flow and direction

[RENDERING STYLE]
high detail 3D sculpt style, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, 
no color, grayscale shading, clean linework, game concept art quality

[NEGATIVE]
no background scenery, no color tones, no extra characters, 
no cluttered backgrounds

items.title: Parody Luxury Product Advertisement
items.titleZh: High-impact parody e-commerce infographic for “{argument name="product" default="Four Loko"}” malt beverage. Foreground: An extreme close-up of a rough, weathered hand holding a tall, brightly colored can of {argument name="product" default="Four Loko"} toward the camera. The can is slightly cold with visible condensation droplets and a loud, chaotic flavor design. The hand and can have a slight macro-lens blur for depth, with the can still reading clearly as the hero product. Central Subject: In the mid-ground, a funny, disheveled {argument name="subject" default="homeless-looking man"} sitting casually on a milk crate in an urban alley. He has a scruffy beard, messy hair, layered worn clothing, and a huge unbothered grin. He should look chaotic but oddly charismatic, like the accidental king of bad decisions. He is posed like a confident lifestyle-ad model, proudly showing off the can. Background & Lighting: A ridiculously polished ad-style backdrop mixed with a grimy city alley setting. Soft-focus urban textures, dumpster shapes, graffiti hints, and scattered clutter in the distance. Add dramatic studio lighting, soft glow, rainbow prism flares, and subtle light leaks to make the whole thing look way too premium for the subject matter. A few blurred {argument name="product" default="Four Loko"} cans can float artistically in the background for extra absurdity. Typography & Layout (Bold sans-serif, white and neon accent styling): Top Center (Background): Massive, bold text reading “{argument name="brand name" default="FOUR LOKO"}” positioned behind the subject. Top Right: Bold text reading “The Champagne of Bad Ideas”. Mid-Left: “Premium chaos and zero self-control” Mid-Right: Large, bold “23” with the text “ounces of terrible decisions.” Bottom-Right: Large, bold “1" with the text “can to ruin tomorrow.” Optional small callout text near the bottom: “Now with more regret.” Style: Ultra-detailed, 8k parody commercial photography, sharp focus on the can, shallow depth of field, vibrant trashy color palette, clean advertising composition, exaggerated premium product-ad aesthetic, funny visual contrast between polished branding and the wrecked subject.
items.promptZh: “{argument name="product" default="Four Loko"}”麦芽饮料的高影响力模仿电子商务信息图。前景：一只粗糙、饱经风霜的手拿着一罐高高的、色彩鲜艳的{argument name="product" default="Four Loko"}对着镜头的特写。罐头有点冷，有明显的冷凝水滴和响亮、混乱的风味设计。手和罐子的深度有轻微的微距镜头模糊，而罐子仍然作为英雄产品清晰地阅读。中心主题：在中景，一个有趣、衣衫不整的{argument name="subject" default="无家可归的男人"}随意地坐在城市小巷的牛奶箱上。他留着邋遢的胡须，凌乱的头发，穿着层层叠叠的破旧衣服，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。他应该看起来很混乱，但却有一种奇怪的魅力，就像偶然的错误决定之王一样。他摆出一副自信的生活方式广告模特的姿势，自豪​​地炫耀着罐子。背景和灯光：极其精美的广告风格背景与肮脏的城市小巷环境混合在一起。柔焦城市纹理、垃圾箱形状、涂鸦提示以及远处零散的杂物。添加戏剧性的工作室灯光、柔和的光芒、彩虹棱镜耀斑和微妙的漏光，使整个事物看起来对于主题来说过于优质。一些模糊的{argument name="product" default="Four Loko"}罐头可以艺术地漂浮在背景中，增添了额外的荒谬感。版式和布局（粗体无衬线、白色和霓虹灯口音样式）：顶部中心（背景）：大量粗体文本“{argument name =“brand name”default =“FOUR LOKO”}”位于主题后面。右上：粗体文字“坏主意的香槟”。中左：“高级混乱和零自我控制”中右：大而粗的“23”，文字“盎司的可怕决定”。右下角：大而粗的“1”，上面写着“可以毁掉明天”。底部附近可选的小标注文字：“现在更加遗憾。”风格：超详细的 8K 模仿商业摄影、对罐头的锐利聚焦、浅景深、充满活力的垃圾调色板、干净的广告构图、夸张的优质产品广告美感、精美的品牌与失事主题之间有趣的视觉对比。

High-impact e-commerce infographic for "{argument name="product name" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}" wireless earbuds.
Foreground: An extreme close-up of a hand holding an open, glossy white wireless earbud charging case toward the camera. Inside the case are two sleek white earbuds with black speaker accents. A tiny, glowing green LED status light is visible on the front of the case. The hand and case have a slight macro-lens blur to create a sense of depth.
Central Subject: In the mid-ground, a smiling young woman with freckles and wavy {argument name="hair color" default="pastel-pink"} hair. She is wearing a vibrant lime-green knit beanie and a psychedelic, black and white-striped long-sleeve shirt. One white earbud is tucked into her ear.
Background & Lighting: A clean, soft-focus studio backdrop with a light-gray gradient. The scene is accented by diagonal rainbow prism lens flares and soft light leaks. Several blurred white earbuds float artistically in the background. The lighting is soft and professional, highlighting the glossy plastic of the product.
Typography & Layout (Sans-Serif, White):
Top Center (Background): Massive, bold text reading "{argument name="main brand text" default="AIRPODS"}" (positioned behind the model).
Top Right: Bold text reading "Apple Pods Pro 3".
Mid-Left: "Premium sound and noise cancellation"
Mid-Right: Large, bold "30" with the text "hours of battery life."
Bottom-Right: Large, bold "1" with the text "year warranty."
Style: 8k resolution, commercial product photography, vibrant color palette, sharp focus on the product case, shallow depth of field, clean advertising aesthetic.

items.title: Professional Tool Launch Poster
items.titleZh: 1. Design a modern tech-style poster for an "AI Agent tool launch," vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, with a clear and eye-catching main title and a subtitle explaining product value. Use a black, white, and gray color palette with fluorescent green accents. Include abstract networks, code windows, and agent nodes. The overall look should resemble a high-end SaaS launch poster, and text must be accurate and readable. 2. Generate a cover image suitable for an X/Twitter long-form post titled "2026 AI Tool Trends," horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, with a clean and sophisticated style. Include the title and 3 keywords: Agent / Workflow / Automation. The background should be a combination of desktop workflows, browsers, terminals, and data panels, with a layout like a tech media header. 3. Generate an advertisement for a Web3 wallet security tool. The center of the image shows a phone displaying the wallet interface, surrounded by on-chain addresses, risk alerts, shield icons, and transaction path visualizations. The style should be professional and trustworthy, with the Chinese title: "Making every on-chain operation safer." 4. Create a Chinese infographic titled "The 5 Layers of AI Agent Capabilities," including: understanding tasks, calling tools, reading data, executing operations, and reviewing/optimizing. Show this in a clear hierarchical structure, each layer with a small icon, white background, and tech-blue accents. 5. Generate a one-page 4-panel comic strip about a creator going from manually searching for info, writing copy, and making images to completing the workflow automatically with an AI Agent. The style should be lighthearted and humorous, with consistent characters and short, clear Chinese dialogue. The last panel should highlight "double the efficiency." 6. Generate a roadmap visual for an AI x Crypto project, including three phases: Q2, Q3, and Q4: MVP, Agent Marketplace, and Onchain Automation. The style should look like a product page in a funding deck—clean, credible, futuristic, and with clearly readable text.
items.prompt: 1. 为「AI Agent 工具发布」设计一张现代科技感海报，竖版 4:5，主标题清晰醒目，副标题解释产品价值，使用黑白灰+荧光绿点缀，包含抽象网络、代码窗口、智能体节点，整体像高端 SaaS 发布海报，文字必须准确可读。 2. 生成一张适合 X/Twitter 长文的封面图，主题是「2026 AI 工具趋势」，横版 16:9，风格干净高级，包含标题、3个关键词：Agent / Workflow / Automation，背景是桌面工作流、浏览器、终端、数据面板的组合，排版像科技媒体头图。 3. 为一款 Web3 钱包安全工具生成广告图，画面中心是一部手机展示钱包界面，周围有链上地址、风险预警、盾牌图标、交易路径可视化，风格专业可信，中文标题：让每一笔链上操作更安全。 4. 制作一张中文信息图，主题是「AI Agent 的 5 层能力」，包含：理解任务、调用工具、读取数据、执行操作、复盘优化。用清晰层级结构展示，每一层配一个小图标，白底，科技蓝点缀。 5. 生成一页 4 格漫画，讲一个创作者从手动找资料、写文案、做图，到用 AI Agent 自动完成工作流的过程。风格轻松幽默，人物一致，中文对白简短清晰，最后一格突出“效率翻倍”。 6. 为一个 AI x Crypto 项目生成路线图视觉图，包含 Q2、Q3、Q4 三个阶段：MVP、Agent Marketplace、Onchain Automation。风格像融资 Deck 里的产品页，干净、可信、有未来感，文字清晰可读。

items.title: Vintage Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster
items.titleZh: Create a bold vintage Japanese-inspired poster on a square canvas with a fierce front-facing tiger head as the single central subject, perfectly symmetrical and filling most of the frame. The tiger is roaring with its mouth wide open, showing long curved ivory fangs, smaller lower teeth, a vivid pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, intense yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes over saturated orange fur with white cheek and neck fur. Add ornamental swirling stripe patterns on the forehead to give the face a stylized mythic look. Use a gritty retro screenprint or risograph texture with visible grain, worn ink, slightly distressed edges, and a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, muted pink, and small accents of yellow. The background should be a flat textured orange-red field. In the top right, include 1 small technical diagram panel showing a side-view tiger skeleton in thin cream line art with compact vertical Japanese annotation text beneath and beside it, like a pseudo-scientific label block. In the bottom left, include 3 vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon with the label 心, the second contains crossed bones with the label 力, and the third contains three claw marks with the label 本能. Across the bottom center, place 2 very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black drop shadows and a rough hand-cut block print feel: 猛獣. Keep the overall composition aggressive, iconic, poster-like, centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, tattoo flash energy, and vintage animal anatomy chart styling.

items.title: Occult Cyber-Gothic Collage Poster
items.titleZh: A dark occult cyber-gothic collage poster in vertical format, dense and layered like a ritualistic noir album cover, with a distressed black, sepia, bronze, and deep crimson palette. Combine analog decay, glitch textures, scanned paper, technical schematics, surveillance graphics, sacred geometry, and fragmented photomontage into one unified composition. On the right side, feature a large aged human skull in profile, highly detailed, weathered, and partially overlaid with circles, target marks, sigils, thin grid lines, and red diagram annotations. Near the upper center, place a mysterious woman with long dark hair and pale skin, wearing a low-cut black garment, posed sensually with one hand raised near her face; behind her head, add a large dim red halo ring. On the left upper quadrant, include the draped back or shoulder of a pale classical-statue-like figure, ghostly and fragmentary. In the lower middle-right, place a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess wearing layered beads, necklaces, and ceremonial adornment, partially obscured by texture and collage interference. In the lower right, show one worn cloth doll or voodoo-style rag figure hanging or suspended, with visible seams and outstretched limbs. In the bottom center, depict a rainy night street scene with 1 lone trench-coated figure walking away under dim lights and 1 car parked or idling on the wet road, reflections glowing red on the pavement. In the lower left, add a faceted black pyramid or crystal-like geometric form emerging from darkness. Scatter exactly 7 visible Latin text blocks throughout the design, styled as aged serif typography and cryptic inscriptions: "IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.", "ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.", "PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA", "EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.", "III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.", "COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.", and "IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO". Add small UI-like microtext, barcode fragments, tiny charts, occult emblems, crosshair symbols, and illegible data panels across the entire image. The composition should feel oppressive, esoteric, cinematic, and surreal, with heavy texture, layered transparency, subtle red accents, chiaroscuro lighting, and a premium dark-art poster finish.
items.promptZh: 垂直格式的黑暗神秘网络哥特式拼贴海报，密集且分层，就像仪式性的黑色专辑封面一样，采用仿旧的黑色、棕褐色、青铜色和深红色调色板。将模拟衰减、故障纹理、扫描纸张、技术原理图、监视图形、神圣几何学和碎片蒙太奇组合成一个统一的构图。右侧是一个大型老年人类头骨的轮廓，非常详细，风化，部分覆盖有圆圈、目标标记、印记、细网格线和红色图表注释。在上中心附近，有一个神秘的女人，有着长长的黑发和苍白的皮肤，穿着一件低胸的黑色衣服，一只手举到脸附近，摆出性感的姿势；在她的头后面，添加一个大的暗红色光环。在左上象限，包括一个苍白的古典雕像般的人物的后背或肩膀，幽灵般且支离破碎。在右下方，放置一个深色皮肤的仪式人物或女祭司，戴着分层的珠子、项链和仪式装饰品，部分被纹理和拼贴干扰遮盖。右下角展示了一个破旧的布娃娃或巫毒风格的布娃娃，悬挂或悬挂着，有明显的接缝和伸展的四肢。底部中央描绘了雨夜的街景，1 个穿着风衣的孤独人物在昏暗的灯光下走开，1 辆汽车停在或闲置在潮湿的道路上，人行道上的倒影发出红色的光。在左下角，添加一个多面的黑色金字塔或从黑暗中出现的水晶状几何形状。在整个设计中散布 7 个可见的拉丁文本块，风格为古老的衬线排版和神秘的铭文：“IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.”、“ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.”、“PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA”、“EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.”、“III FRAGMENTUM” Infinitum。”、“COR AMAT；MENS Dubitat；ANIMA LACERATUR。”和“IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO”。在整个图像中添加类似于 UI 的小型缩微文本、条形码片段、微小图表、神秘标志、十字准线符号和难以辨认的数据面板。构图应该给人压抑、深奥、电影般和超现实的感觉，具有厚重的质感、分层的透明度、微妙的红色调、明暗对比照明和优质的黑暗艺术海报效果。

items.title: Vintage Beagle Botanical Plate
items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a vintage naturalist encyclopedia plate in the style of a 19th-century scientific animal-and-botany illustration. Keep the same beagle and the same potted houseplant from the reference as the main subjects, but redraw them as finely inked and lightly hand-colored specimen illustrations on an aged off-white page. Preserve the dog's seated pose, collar and tag, and the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout with 8 labeled figure areas total: 1 large central full-body beagle study, 1 large right-side plant study, 4 left-column inset studies labeled “Fig. 1. Head (Frontal View)”, “Fig. 2. Head (Profile View)”, “Fig. 3. Collar & Tag”, and “Fig. 4. Forepaw (Anterior View)”, 3 bottom comparative detail studies labeled “Eye”, “Nose”, and “Leaf (Detail)”, plus 1 bottom-right notes panel. Add delicate dotted annotation callouts around the main dog and plant identifying features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, coat, leaves, stem, and roots. Include the page title “THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT” at the top, the subtitle “Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”, corner plate markings “PL. I.” and “Tab. 1.”, a central caption “Fig. 5. The Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris) Adult. Seated Position.”, a plant caption “Fig. 6. Houseplant in Pot (Dracaena sp.)”, a bottom section title “Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details”, and a notes box containing 5 lines: “Location: Indoor”, “Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animal and potted plant.”, “Date: May 17, 2024”, “Observer: Naturalist’s Journal”, and “Plate I.” Use clean engraved linework, restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, decorative border corners, and a symmetrical museum-plate composition.

items.titleZh: A simple centered full-body illustration of a cute chibi {argument name="animal type" default="rabbit"} character on a plain {argument name="background color" default="light gray"} background, drawn in a flat cartoon style with thick clean black outlines and minimal shading. Keep the composition vertically centered, symmetrical, clean, and diagram-like, with the cute mascot character and pose-estimation overlay as the sole subject.

items.title: AI Guangzhou Food Map Comparison
items.titleZh: A comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray square grid, designed like a social media test result poster. At the top are 2 large side-by-side titles in bold sans serif text: “GPT image 2” above the left image and “Nano Banana” above the right image. Below them are 2 vertically oriented illustrated posters placed next to each other with a small gap. Both posters depict the same concept: a hand-drawn foodie walking map of Guangzhou in Chinese, but rendered in 2 different visual styles. The left poster is more detailed, textured, dense, and richly illustrated, while the right poster is cleaner, flatter, and simpler. The left poster has a warm cream paper background and an intricate vintage hand-painted travel-map style with fine linework, watercolor texture, decorative flowers and lychee fruits, miniature buildings, roads, river areas, and many food illustrations. The large Chinese title at the top of the left poster reads “广州 吃货暴走地图”. The map includes roughly 12 featured food spots distributed across the city, each shown as a small food illustration with Chinese labels and short handwritten-style annotations. Visible foods include skewers, roast poultry, noodle dishes, clay pot dishes, rice rolls, dumplings, soups, and dessert bowls, with landmarks such as the Canton Tower and riverfront scenery integrated into the map. The right poster also has the Chinese title “广州 吃货暴走地图” and shows the same general idea but in a cleaner infographic-like map style with simplified roads, icons, floral and lychee border decorations, food callouts, a river, the Canton Tower, and approximately 12 labeled food illustrations around the map. At the bottom of the overall comparison graphic is 1 rounded black text panel with a white outline. Attached to its upper left edge is 1 bright yellow rounded tab label reading “提示词” in bold black Chinese characters. Inside the black panel is a block of white Chinese text describing the image-generation prompt; it appears as a multi-line paragraph. The composition is centered, high contrast, and presented as a polished AI image comparison post for Chinese social media, with crisp typography, poster-like symmetry, and a clean test-benchmark aesthetic.

items.title: China May Day Rail Travel Infographic
items.titleZh: Create a polished Xiaohongshu-style Chinese travel infographic poster in a soft watercolor map aesthetic, square format, showing a five-day high-speed-rail travel route through China. Large brush-calligraphy headline at the top left: {argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}. Directly below it, a green ribbon subtitle with white Chinese text: {argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}. Add a smaller line of Chinese text under the subtitle: “一路向北·发现中国之美”. The background is a pale illustrated map of central and northern China in beige and light sage green, with faint mountain textures, soft rivers, and subtle floral decoration in the corners. A vertical curved railway line runs from the bottom center upward to the top center, connecting 4 cities with orange-red location pins and bold red Chinese city names. The 4 cities are, from bottom to top: 广州, 湖南, 武汉, 北京. Along the route, place small white high-speed train icons on the track and 3 green travel-time labels: “广州→湖南 高铁约2.5小时”, “湖南→武汉 高铁约1.5小时”, and “武汉→北京 高铁约4.5小时”. Near each city, include a scenic collage or illustrated landmark cluster: Guangzhou with a modern skyline and Canton Tower; Hunan with green mountains and cultural scenery; Wuhan with Yellow Crane Tower and historic architecture; Beijing with the Forbidden City / imperial palace architecture. Add small scenic tag labels near the city illustrations reading “花城广州·美食之都”, “山水湖南·人文荟萃”, “江城武汉·英雄之城”, and “中国首都·历史与现代交融”. Under the main title, show exactly 4 minimalist icon badges with short Chinese labels, evenly spaced in one row: a camera icon labeled “精选景点”, a train icon labeled “高铁直达”, a suitcase icon labeled “轻松出行”, and a star icon labeled “美食推荐”. Around the map, place 4 rounded rectangular itinerary cards with green headers, cream backgrounds, and photo thumbnails. Each card must contain day-by-day plans, a starred section for recommended attractions, and a starred section for recommended food. The 4 cards are: 1) top right card titled “北京｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 2) right middle card titled “武汉｜1.5天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 3) left middle card titled “湖南｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 4) bottom left card titled “广州｜1天”, with exactly 1 day row, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo. Fill the itinerary text with compact Chinese travel-plan copy in a practical social-media infographic style. At the lower right, add a rounded notes panel containing exactly 2 sections with green titles: “行程亮点” and “出行小贴士”. Under “行程亮点”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Under “出行小贴士”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Decorate the notes area with a small luggage illustration and a handwritten-style diagonal Chinese phrase in green, such as “出发吧！去感受春天的风景”. At the bottom center, place a small rounded summary bar titled “行程总览”, including exactly 4 summary items with icons: total duration “总时长：约6.5天”, total distance “总里程：约2100公里”, recommended transportation “推荐交通：高铁”, and best travel period “最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”. In the bottom left foreground, place a large sleek white high-speed train angled diagonally upward, partially overlapping the border as a hero element. Add a calligraphic closing slogan near the train in Chinese: “最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”. Use an elegant olive-green, sage, beige, and warm red palette, combining traditional Chinese travel-poster charm with modern infographic clarity, crisp typography, soft shadows, rounded cards, realistic photo inserts, and clean editorial layout.

items.title: Landscape Archive Model Template
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-quality, professional 'Landscape Archive Model' visual based on {argument name="subject" default="The Great Wall / Mt. Everest / The Bund / Pearl River"} suitable for a series.

This is not a regular map or simple landscape illustration, but a high-end archival visual combining '2D map drafting + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel'. The image should look like a real physical geography research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, with a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium texture.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {argument name="subject content" default="Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing"}
Subject Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: [Core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruins, main urban area]
Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / urban landmarks / road network / hydrology / nature-city relationship / setting collection display]
Style: {argument name="style" default="geographic surveying style, paper-cut model style, architectural proposal style, museum archival style, urban planning style"}
Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white]
Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green]
Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue hydrographic lines, yellow numbered markers]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square]

[Composition]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth. The base plate has real thickness with visible section structures on the edges, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained information layer, including contour lines, road networks, hydrology, zonal boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area, a 3D model 'grows' out of the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If [Subject Type] is Natural Terrain: The subject consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain undulations.

If [Subject Type] is Urban Space: The subject consists of the core urban area, CBD, old town blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing architectural massing, urban identity, spatial layers, and planning structure.

If [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape: It integrates both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases.

[Detail Requirements]
- Surface retains map paper and professional information feel.
- Terrain areas should have contours, slope layers, and depressions.
- Architectural areas should have massing, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Greenery/forests use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks use fine lines without being distracting.
- Landmarks should be clearly identifiable.
- Sci-fi/fantasy elements should retain the archival model feel rather than appearing as pure scene illustrations.

[Annotation System]
The map board edge needs complete and restrained annotation modules, including frame lines, scales, legend areas, title areas, archive numbers, index marks, note tags, and simple symbol keys. Text doesn't need to be fully legible but must present a realistic, clear, precise, and orderly archival layout.

[Camera & Lighting]
Use an oblique top-down isometric or sandbox composition, with the camera at about 30 to 45 degrees, showing the map plane, model height, edge thickness, and annotation area. Lighting should be soft and natural with delicate real shadows on a clean background, avoiding a cartoonish or cheap game UI look.
items.prompt:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="中国长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 上海外滩 / 广州珠江"}创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

items.title: Scientific Neuron Anatomy Poster
items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a {argument name="subject" default="neuron"} on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. At the far end, the axon branches into exactly 15 thin terminal fibers, each ending in a rounded synaptic bulb with pale peach and pink tips. The main central figure should look sculptural, organic, and slightly glossy, with intricate membrane textures, subtle beige, ivory, silver, brown, and violet coloration, and extremely fine linework for the distal branches. Surround the centerpiece with 6 labeled educational inset sections arranged like a textbook infographic: top left a title block reading {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"} with a short explanatory paragraph and a numbered structure list containing exactly 10 items; upper right a smaller monochrome full-neuron sketch labeled {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}; lower left a cell body soma detail diagram with labels pointing to internal organelles; bottom left a myelin sheath cross-section cylinder diagram; lower center a square grayscale microscopic view panel with 4 labels; right center an electrical signal section with a small action potential graph showing membrane potential versus time; lower right a synapse close-up drawing with receptor and neurotransmitter labeling. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with the central neuron dominating most of the canvas, landscape orientation, extremely high resolution, crisp educational poster design, and a refined neutral aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 在干净、温暖的灰白色纸背景上创建一张非常详细的{argument name="subject" default="neuron"}科学解剖海报，以博物馆品质的 3D 铅笔画和超现实生物插图的混合形式呈现。该构图以四分之三视图中的一个大神经元为中心，在有纹理的细胞体内有一个超大的球形紫色核，许多分支树突像冬天的树枝一样向外伸展，还有一个长轴突向右斜向下延伸。轴突被部分切除以显示其内部结构，并包裹在分段的蓝灰色髓鞘中，朗飞结处有可见的间隙。在远端，轴突精确地分支成 15 根细末端纤维，每根纤维末端都是一个带有浅桃色和粉红色尖端的圆形突触球。主要的中心人物应该看起来像雕塑、有机的、略带光泽，具有复杂的膜纹理、微妙的米色、象牙色、银色、棕色和紫色，以及远端分支的极其精细的线条。中心装饰周围有 6 个带标签的教育插图部分，排列得像教科书信息图：左上角有一个标题栏，上面写着 {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"}，有一个简短的解释段落和一个包含 10 个项目的编号结构列表；右上角是一个较小的单色全神经元草图，标记为 {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}；左下是细胞体体细胞详细图，标签指向内部细胞器；左下为髓鞘圆柱截面图；下部中心是一个带有 4 个标签的方形灰度显微视图面板；右中心是电信号部分，其中有一个小动作电位图，显示膜电位与时间的关系；右下是带有受体和神经递质标记的突触特写图。包括精细的衬线字体、精致的引导线、主神经元上的小圆圈数字，以及优雅的古老科学板块与现代生物医学可视化相结合的感觉。保持布局通风和平衡，中央神经元主导大部分画布，横向，极高分辨率，清晰的教育海报设计，以及精致的中性美学。

items.title: Overdecorated Sophie Magic Poster
items.titleZh: A highly embellished full-body anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}, a young elegant female alchemist-mage standing in the center of a vast celestial library laboratory. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a soft short bob with a side ponytail and a large crystalline flower hair ornament, though her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block. She wears an ornate white and icy-blue dress with silver filigree, corset lacing, layered ruffles, translucent trailing panels, detached flowing sleeves, gemstone pendants, thigh garter ornaments, and white high-heeled ankle boots with metallic trims. Two glowing blue potion bottles hang at her hip. Her pose is graceful and confident: one hand raised with a floating faceted blue crystal hovering above her palm, the other holding an open magic book that projects transparent holographic pages and arcane interface diagrams in neon blue. The environment is a grand circular observatory-like library with towering bookshelves, alchemical instruments, astrolabes, hanging ornaments, glassware, candles, and luminous magical symbols. A huge backlit arched window behind her casts cool heavenly light. The floor beneath her is covered in glowing concentric magic circles and reflections, surrounded by crystalline blue flowers and sparkling particles. The composition is vertical, centered, and extremely polished, with dense decorative detail, ethereal lighting, layered translucency, shimmering highlights, and a palette dominated by white, silver, sapphire, and pale violet. Include large decorative title text on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}, smaller Japanese text beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ソフィー"}, a small "CV:" line below, a short block of tiny English flavor text on the lower left, and a luminous blue hologram panel on the right with the word {argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}. Make it feel like a luxurious character key visual or promotional poster for a magical science heroine, ultra-detailed, glossy, radiant, and intentionally over-the-top.
items.promptZh: 一幅高度装饰的全身动漫奇幻插图，描绘的是一位年轻优雅的女炼金术士{argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}，她站在一座巨大的天体图书馆实验室的中心。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="platinumblond"}头发，留着柔软的短波波头，扎着侧马尾辫，戴着大水晶花发饰，尽管她的脸被一个扁平的、苍白的方形审查块遮住了。她穿着华丽的白色和冰蓝色连衣裙，饰有银色细丝、紧身胸衣系带、分层荷叶边、半透明拖尾镶片、独立飘逸袖子、宝石吊坠、大腿吊袜带装饰，以及带有金属饰边的白色高跟踝靴。她的臀部挂着两个发光的蓝色药水瓶。她的姿势优雅而自信：一只手举起，手掌上方悬浮着一块漂浮的多面蓝色水晶，另一只手拿着一本打开的魔法书，上面投射出透明的全息页面和霓虹蓝色的神秘界面图。环境是一个宏伟的圆形天文台般的图书馆，里面有高耸的书架、炼金仪器、星盘、悬挂装饰品、玻璃器皿、蜡烛和发光的魔法符号。她身后一扇巨大的背光拱形窗户投射出凉爽的天堂般的光线。她脚下的地板上覆盖着发光的同心魔法阵和反射，周围环绕着水晶般的蓝色花朵和闪闪发光的颗粒。构图垂直、居中、极其抛光，具有密集的装饰细节、空灵的灯光、分层的半透明、闪烁的亮点，以及以白色、银色、蓝宝石和浅紫色为主的调色板。在左侧添加大的装饰性标题文本{argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}，在下方添加较小的日文文本{argument name="subtitle text" default="ソfuィー"}，下面有一个小“CV:”行，在左下角添加一小块英文风格的小文本，在右侧添加发光的蓝色全息图面板，其中包含单词{argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}。让它感觉像是神奇科学女主角的豪华角色主视觉或宣传海报，超详细、有光泽、容光焕发，并且故意夸张。

The environment is a grand circular observatory-like library with towering bookshelves, alchemical instruments, astrolabes, hanging ornaments, glassware, candles, and luminous magical symbols. A huge backlit arched window behind her casts cool heavenly light. The floor beneath her is covered in glowing concentric magic circles and reflections, surrounded by crystalline blue flowers and sparkling particles. The composition is vertical, centered, and extremely polished, with dense decorative detail, ethereal lighting, layered translucency, shimmering highlights, and a palette dominated by white, silver, sapphire, and pale violet. items.title: Pixel Game Asset Atlas Template
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {argument name="game theme" default="Demon Slayer/Tanjiro"}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {argument name="game type" default="Side-scrolling action"}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {argument name="style" default="16-bit retro arcade pixel style"}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.
items.prompt:
请根据【游戏主题：{argument name="游戏主题" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「像素世界资产图鉴 / Pixel World Asset Atlas」。

这不是普通像素插画，也不是单张游戏场景图，而是一张面向游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计和视觉提案的“2D像素游戏资产总览图”。画面需要像一张完整的游戏素材说明板，把一个【游戏类型：{argument name="游戏类型" default="横版动作"}】所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss和装饰元素系统化整理在同一张图中，形成清晰、专业、可复用的游戏资产图鉴。

【基础设定】
主题世界观：【游戏主题】
游戏类型：【游戏类型】
时代背景：【时代背景】
主角身份：【主角身份】
敌人类型：【敌人类型】
主要场景：【主要场景环境】
整体风格：【风格方向，例如{argument name="风格" default="16-bit复古街机像素风"}】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
点缀色：【点缀色】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，横版4:3】
如没有填写，自动按照游戏主题最优方案进行匹配。

【整体画面要求】
画面采用横版大画布，浅色或低干扰背景，整体像一张游戏开发资产表、像素设定集展开页、说明书式资源目录。所有元素都应为统一像素密度的2D pixel art sprite，具有清晰黑色或深色描边、有限色阶、复古游戏质感。不要生成真实摄影风、3D渲染风、厚涂插画风或电影海报风。重点是“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富、可开发感强”。

【版式结构】
整张图采用模块化网格排版，用细线分割不同资源区域。每个区域需要有编号标题和简短分类标签，整体阅读路径为从左到右、从上到下。版式应具有说明书、游戏开发文档、素材图鉴、设定板的秩序感。信息密度要高，但不能混乱；每个模块内部的元素应等距排列，保持清晰可读。

【必须包含的模块】
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等。动作帧应横向排列，像游戏sprite sheet。
2. 敌人单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重装、精英单位等。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投掷物、特效、拾取物等。
4. 基础地形砖块模块：展示地面、墙体、平台、转角、不同材质地块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、石头、障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙、梯子、营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖、洞口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门、设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型Boss、特殊载具、巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、指示牌、开关、机关。

【视觉细节要求】
所有资源需要保持统一的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观一致性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形砖块可拼接；道具和机关有功能识别度；Boss元素需有压迫感。

items.title: Futuristic STEM Classroom with Holograms
items.titleZh: A bright futuristic classroom or science museum learning lab filled with school-age children interacting with large mixed-reality holograms, cinematic ultra-detailed photorealism. The scene is a wide-angle interior during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, modern tables, bookshelves, digital displays, and a clean high-tech educational atmosphere. About 9 children and 1 adult teacher are spread across the room, actively exploring science exhibits with gestures and touch interactions. In the center, a glowing semi-transparent holographic human heart floats at chest height while 3 children gather around it, reaching toward it in curiosity. Suspended overhead is a large holographic solar system mobile with exactly 9 planets orbiting a bright sun, with luminous orbit trails and a magical scientific visualization style. On the left side, one child interacts with a tall vertical holographic DNA double helix. On the front-left table, there is a circular tabletop hologram of a miniature mountain-and-river ecosystem containing exactly 4 visible animals: an elephant, a deer, a llama or alpaca, and a bear. On the back-left table, there is a circular holographic architectural city model featuring a grand classical domed building and surrounding structures. On the right-front table, there is a large ball-and-stick molecular model made of glowing spheres and rods. In the mid-right and upper-right space, include additional floating science holograms: exactly 2 geometric polyhedra, exactly 2 molecule diagrams, exactly 2 spherical energy or data globes, and 1 hourglass-like abstract hologram. The children should be ethnically diverse, dressed casually, engaged, amazed, collaborative, and looking at different holographic subjects. Use soft volumetric sunlight, realistic reflections on glass and tabletops, subtle blue and gold glow from the holograms, shallow atmospheric haze, and a premium inspirational STEM-education advertisement aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 明亮的未来教室或科学博物馆学习实验室，里面挤满了学龄儿童，与大型混合现实全息图、电影般的超详细照片写实互动。场景是温暖的午后阳光下的广角室内，有落地玻璃窗、现代化的桌子、书架、数字显示器，以及干净的高科技教育氛围。大约 9 名儿童和 1 名成人老师分布在房间里，通过手势和触摸互动积极探索科学展品。在中心，一颗发光的半透明全息人体心脏漂浮在胸部高度，3 个孩子聚集在它周围，好奇地伸向它。头顶上悬挂着一个巨大的全息太阳系，正好有 9 颗行星围绕着明亮的太阳运行，具有发光的轨道轨迹和神奇的科学可视化风格。在左侧，一名儿童正在与一个高大的垂直全息 DNA 双螺旋相互作用。左前方的桌子上有一个圆形桌面全息图，显示了一个微型山河生态系统，其中恰好包含 4 种可见动物：大象、鹿、美洲驼或羊驼和熊。左后方的桌子上有一个圆形的全息建筑城市模型，具有宏伟的古典圆顶建筑和周围的结构。右前桌上有一个由发光球体和棒材制成的大型球棒分子模型。在右中和右上空间中，包括额外的浮动科学全息图：正好 2 个几何多面体、正好 2 个分子图、正好 2 个球形能量或数据地球仪以及 1 个沙漏状抽象全息图。孩子们应该是多元化的种族，穿着休闲，投入，惊讶，合作，并观看不同的全息主题。使用柔和的体积阳光、玻璃和桌面上的真实反射、全息图发出的微妙蓝色和金色光芒、浅层大气薄雾以及优质的鼓舞人心的 STEM 教育广告美学。

items.title: Cinematic Heist Mastermind at Whiteboard
items.titleZh: A cinematic, moody heist-planning scene in a dimly lit office at night, shot in a realistic thriller style. A single adult man stands with his back mostly to the camera, slightly turned in profile, writing on a huge whiteboard filled edge to edge with tactical notes, building sketches, floor plans, arrows, routes, and hand-drawn diagrams. He has wavy dark hair and wears a dark olive or charcoal casual jacket over dark trousers, giving the impression of a mastermind strategist. The whiteboard is the focal point and contains multiple readable planning areas: the top left title says "OPERATION NIGHTHAWK"; the left column has 3 sections labeled "OBJECTIVE," "TARGET," and "TIMELINE"; the upper right has 2 labeled diagram areas, "ENTRY PLAN" and "CAMERA NETWORK"; the lower middle-right has 4 labeled planning blocks, "TRANSIT," "EQUIPMENT," "HOTEL ROUTE," and "CONTINGENCIES." Include sketched building elevations, a rooftop access drawing, loading bay notes, room labels, arrows in black and red marker, and a small van sketch near the lower center. The room is warm and shadowy with amber practical lighting. On the left side of the frame, show a desk lamp glowing over a dark wooden desk with scattered papers, and a wall with 3 framed black-and-white photographs arranged vertically. Composition is a medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot, the man centered slightly left, the whiteboard dominating the background. High contrast, soft filmic grain, tense atmosphere, realistic textures, prestige TV crime-drama aesthetic similar to a brilliant planner preparing a robbery, but not depicting any specific copyrighted character. Add a white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner.

items.title: Short-Form Attention Tax Poster
items.titleZh:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

items.title: Chinese Tomato Nutrition Poster
items.titleZh:
A clean premium food advertisement poster on a light gray-white studio background, featuring {argument name="fruit name" default="tomatoes"} as the hero subject. In the center, show exactly 7 tomato pieces arranged on a shallow round wooden plate: 5 whole ripe red tomatoes stacked in a natural pyramid, 1 halved tomato standing upright at the front center with glossy flesh and visible seeds, and 1 wedge slice placed at the lower right foreground. The tomatoes are fresh, vivid red, covered with realistic water droplets, with green stems attached to most whole fruits. Add a few green leaves and two small yellow tomato blossoms near the lower right edge for freshness accents. Use soft commercial lighting, gentle shadows, sharp focus, and highly realistic texture, in a polished supermarket-poster style.

Design the layout as a Chinese nutrition and freshness infographic poster. In the upper left, place a large two-line Chinese headline with strong typographic hierarchy: the first line in black reads {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}, the second line in large warm red reads {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}. Below it, add a smaller gray Chinese slogan: {argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}. Under the slogan, place exactly 3 simple red line icons in a horizontal row with short Chinese labels and gray sublabels beneath each: 1) a sun icon with text "充足日照" and subtext "自然成熟", 2) a sprout or leaf icon with text "科学种植" and subtext "健康美味", 3) a heart outline icon with text "新鲜采摘" and subtext "产地直供".

On the right side, create a thin curved red guide line framing the tomatoes, with exactly 4 circular nutrient callouts stacked vertically from top to bottom. Each callout is a red or red-orange gradient circle with a white symbol or letter inside, connected to the curve. Use these Chinese labels and explanatory text: 1) top callout with "C" and title "富含维生素C", description "有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成"; 2) second callout with a molecular icon and title "番茄红素", description "强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基"; 3) third callout with a leaf icon and title "膳食纤维", description "促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化"; 4) bottom callout with "K" and title "钾元素", description "有助于维持 心脏健康".

On the left lower side of the tomatoes, add exactly 2 red text feature callouts with fine red leader lines: the upper one titled "美味多汁" with smaller gray text "果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷"; the lower one titled "新鲜采摘" with smaller gray text "人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质".

Across the bottom, place a rounded rectangular nutrition table bar in white with light gray dividers. On the left end, add a solid red rounded label block containing the Chinese title {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}. To its right, show exactly 6 nutrient columns with gray headings and darker values beneath: "能量" "20kcal"; "蛋白质" "0.9g"; "脂肪" "0.2g"; "碳水化合物" "4.2g"; "维生素C" "14mg"; "钾" "179mg". Center a tiny gray footnote below the table: "* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》". Overall style: elegant Chinese fresh-produce marketing poster, balanced whitespace, red-accented infographic design, realistic product photography blended with clean vector UI elements.

items.title: J.Crew Mascot Fashion Editorial
items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image as the character and color-palette guide, transform it into a polished J.Crew-style editorial fashion lookbook starring the same mascot. Replace the infographic/chart layout with a clean 2x2 magazine spread on an off-white background. Add a large serif brand header reading {argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} and an italic subhead reading {argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"}. Show exactly 4 styled outfit photos of the same character, keeping the fuzzy orange fur, big eyes, and black helmet, but placing the mascot in modern menswear inspired by the “best” colors from the reference: 1) “CLASSIC CREW” — seated on a stool in a navy sweater over a crisp white oxford with dark denim; 2) “EASY LAYERS” — standing casually in a teal overshirt, white tee, and charcoal trousers; 3) “POP OF PLUM” — relaxed pose in a plum cardigan with dark pants; 4) “MODERN SPORT” — seated in a black sporty layer with black pants, white socks, and white sneakers. Give each panel a short catalog-style caption under it matching those 4 titles and concise fashion copy. Use soft natural indoor lighting, minimal home-interior editorial settings, premium catalog photography, and a tasteful upscale preppy aesthetic. Add a small closing line centered at the bottom: {argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. PLAYFUL SPIRIT."}

items.prompt: 一份专业的动漫院线分镜头（16：9），标题为《{argument name="标题" default="天空之击"}》，副标题为“{argument name="副标题" default="战士与圣石"}”。干净的浅米色背景，圆角矩形面板排列成三列网格，共 9 个场景。每个场景面板显示：橙色“场景 XX”标签、时间码、场景标题，然后是两个并排的画面，分别标有“开始帧”→“结束帧”，通过白色箭头连接，下面有注释（镜头/对白/特效/动作）。艺术风格：清晰的卡通渲染 {argument name="画风" default="新海诚的×工作室机智，×进击的巨人"}——柔和的画风光线、立体云朵、温暖的金色阳光、电影般的广角镜头、动态动作姿势、浓郁的天蓝和翡翠绿调，搭配黄铜和铜色点缀。需要描绘的场景：1. 广角景——一艘雄伟的蒸汽朋克飞艇，黄铜螺旋桨和飘扬的帆，在高空穿透积云海洋（慢速无人机推入）2.低角度特写一名女战士的靴子和交叉的双腿悬挂在飞艇木制栏杆上，风中头发飘动（静电→微微向上倾斜） 3.鸟瞰视角俯瞰栏杆下方：广阔的翡翠山谷，蜿蜒的河流和远处一个茅草屋顶的小中世纪村庄（眩晕变焦）4.飞艇桥内部——海盗船长戴着三角帽和长大衣，举着一块比蛋稍大、发着蓝光的圣石，脸上有耀眼的青色光（中→石头放大）5.甲板上的船员发现入侵者——一名满脸胡渣的海盗举起一把黄铜中世纪左轮手枪对准她，其他人震惊地转身（两枪→跟着瞄准）6.子弹飞行中极近距离，旋转穿过空中，伴随着运动模糊和烟雾轨迹，朝栏杆方向飞去（子弹时间追踪镜头）7.栏杆——空的。 她被放置的地方什么都没有，子弹穿过空气（快速剪辑，杂音）8。女战士在空中优雅地做月面翻身，背景是明亮的天空，头发和斗篷在动作中拖曳（慢动作，宽→近）9。着陆镜头——她悄无声息地在射手身后降落，低蹲着，手放在剑柄上，海盗转身半空震惊僵住（低角度→对峙） 底部部分包括：“关键角色”一行，有 4 个角色肖像（女战士、海盗船长、射手海盗、一名船员）;一个“音调与方向”盒子（动态动作、风和云粒子，吉卜力风格的奇观与武士的强烈情感）;“音乐与特效计划”时间线（环境风→紧张弦乐→子弹→→沉默）;以及“技术规格”盒装（30 秒，16：9 1920×1080,24 帧，全彩，mp4 H.264）。布局：简洁的信息图，细边框，粉彩色格，每帧内高度细致的动漫关键视觉，专业制作文档美学。
