items.titleZh: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. Center the composition around a 3x3 grid of 9 bordered square panels with thin ornamental Chinese-style corners, evenly spaced and perfectly aligned. Each square contains a large colored number, a Chinese star name, one line beginning with 吉星 or 凶星, and an illustrative symbolic object. Top row has 3 panels: top-left labeled 东南 with a purple-framed panel for number 9 and text 九紫右弼星, plus 吉星: 喜庆、姻缘、贵人, illustrated with purple balloons, a gift box, and a small firework burst; top-center labeled 正南 with an orange-framed panel for number 5 and text 五黄廉贞星, plus 凶星: 灾祸、意外、疾病, illustrated with a gold gourd and ancient Chinese coins tied with a red tassel; top-right labeled 西南 with a gold-framed panel for number 7 and text 七赤破军星, plus 凶星: 破财、口舌、盗贼, illustrated with a brass bell and a silver sword. Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

items.title: Inventor Portrait Memory Map
items.titleZh: A stylized half-body portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a brilliant young woman inventor"} in a dark, moody studio, rendered as a warm amber-and-copper digital painting with semi-realistic detail and subtle sketch-like linework. She faces forward in a relaxed upright pose, cropped from about mid-torso upward, with long dark brown hair swept loosely over one shoulder, a few flyaway strands rim-lit by orange backlight, and thin clear-framed eyeglasses partly visible. Dress her in a glossy mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic: a glowing spherical lattice lamp sits behind her on the left, casting a golden halo and warm edge light around her hair and jacket, while the rest of the background fades into charcoal brown shadow. Behind her, integrate the feeling of a visual memory map or inventor's mind palace: faint technical sketches, geometric construction lines, and handwritten scientific notes drawn directly onto the background like illuminated chalk. Include exactly 2 large wireframe forms on the right side: 1 tilted basket-like lattice ellipsoid near the upper right and 1 faint rectangular diagram with axis-like guide lines near the lower right. Include exactly 1 glowing lattice sphere lamp on the lower left. Add small handwritten text in the upper right that reads “TPMS” with three bullet-like lines underneath: “gyroid”, “diamond”, and “primitive”, and a small formula note reading “E = hv” near the right-center. The overall mood should feel intelligent, elegant, flattering, and slightly futuristic, like a portrait merged with a conceptual memory interface. Use a rich palette of burnt orange, gold, auburn, brown-black, and wine red, with high contrast, luminous highlights, and a polished editorial-art finish.
items.promptZh: 在黑暗、喜怒无常的工作室中拍摄的{argument name="subject" default="一位才华横溢的年轻女发明家"}的风格化半身肖像，渲染为一幅温暖的琥珀色和古铜色数字绘画，具有半写实的细节和微妙的素描般的线条。她面朝前方，摆出一种放松的直立姿势，从躯干中部向上剪短，长长的深棕色头发松散地披在肩上，几缕飘逸的发丝在橙色背光的边缘照亮，薄框透明眼镜若隐若现。为她穿上亮泽的芥末黄色飞行员夹克，搭配深酒红色高领毛衣。灯光充满戏剧性和电影感：一盏发光的球形格子灯位于她身后的左侧，在她的头发和夹克周围投射出金色的光环和温暖的边缘光，而背景的其余部分则淡入炭棕色阴影。在她身后，融入了视觉记忆图或发明家思维宫殿的感觉：淡淡的技术草图、几何构造线以及像发光粉笔一样直接绘制在背景上的手写科学笔记。右侧正好包括 2 个大型线框形式：1 个位于右上方附近的倾斜篮状格子椭圆体和 1 个位于右下方附近带有轴状引导线的微弱矩形图。在左下角正好包括 1 个发光的晶格球体灯。在右上角添加小手写文字，上面写着“TPMS”，下面有三条子弹状的线条：“gyroid”、“diamond”和“primitive”，并在右中心附近添加一个小公式注释，写着“E = hv”。整体氛围应该给人一种聪明、优雅、讨人喜欢、略带未来感的感觉，就像一幅肖像与概念记忆界面的融合。使用丰富的焦橙色、金色、赤褐色、棕黑色和酒红色调色板，具有高对比度、明亮的高光和抛光的编辑艺术效果。

items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed vintage-inspired illustrated travel poster and infographic for {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"}, shown as a sculpted 3D relief map centered on a clean light gray background. At the top, place a huge bold black sans-serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}, with smaller uppercase text below reading TRAVEL GUIDE, flanked by thin horizontal divider lines and a tiny red shield emblem with a white cross. Mark exactly 12 destinations on the map with black dot markers and bold black capsule labels with white uppercase text: BASEL, ZÜRICH, ST. GALLEN, LUCERNE, BERN, INTERLAKEN, CHUR, ST. MORITZ, LUGANO, ZERMATT, GENEVA, and LAUSANNE. items.title: Cute Chinese Tokenization Infographic
items.titleZh: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. Beneath the headline, place a rounded dashed text box containing the definition: "分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。" with the word "Token" highlighted in blue. Below that, add a line of explanatory text: "下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：" with "程序员Left" highlighted in light blue and "人工智能" highlighted in pink. The lower half contains exactly 4 rounded pastel panels arranged left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green and titled "1 词级分词". It includes the subtitle "按完整语义划分文本" and exactly 3 token bubbles: "程序员", "Left", "人工智能". At the bottom of this panel, show the Shiba Inu teacher giving a thumbs up with a speech bubble saying "语义完整，容易理解！". Panel 2 is pale yellow and titled "2 字符级分词". It includes the subtitle "逐字切分文本" and exactly 9 circular token bubbles arranged in rows: "程", "序", "员", "L", "e", "f", "t", "人", "工", "智", "能"—visually presented as individual characters from the example text, in a compact grid. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot holding a pencil, with a speech bubble saying "粒度最细，但序列会很长~". Panel 3 is pale pink and titled "3 子词分词". It includes the subtitle "按词根以及前后缀划分" and exactly 5 token bubbles: "程序", "员", "Left", "人工", "智能". At the bottom, show the Shiba Inu teacher thinking with one paw at its mouth and a question mark above the head, with a speech bubble saying "折中方案，效果 often 很好！". Panel 4 is pale blue and titled "4 字节级分词". It includes the subtitle "将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分" and displays exactly 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7", "A8", "8B", "...", "66", "74", "E4", "BA", "BA", "E8", "83", "BD", "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot again, smiling, with a speech bubble saying "适合处理任意文本！" and a tiny light bulb doodle nearby. Across the very bottom, place a rounded banner note that reads: "不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！". Use soft pastel green, yellow, pink, and blue for the four panels, dark brown handwritten text, subtle shadows, rounded shapes, and adorable kawaii expressions throughout. Keep the composition balanced, clean, and friendly, like a polished social-media science explainer poster.

items.title: Scrapbook Byte-level BPE Explainer
items.titleZh: A cute horizontal educational infographic in a hand-drawn scrapbook style on a pastel desk-and-paper collage background, explaining Chinese word segmentation with byte-level BPE. The scene is divided into 3 clearly separated instructional sections arranged from left to right across a wide banner. On the far left stands a chibi Shiba Inu mascot, {argument name="character name" default="柴小七"}, with warm tan and cream fur, round face, small triangular ears, rosy cheeks, and a curious expression, holding a cup and standing beside a small desk with drawers, pencils, and a chair. Above the dog is a bold rounded white title box with black Chinese text: {argument name="headline text" default="中文分词：Byte-level BPE（BBPE）流程科普"}. In the first teaching section near the upper middle, show 4 small translucent blue token-shaped tiles lined up on a wooden shelf, each labeled “Token”, with a curved arrow and small handwritten Chinese note “词频语料统计” pointing toward the next step. In the second section, place a large magnifying glass highlighting 3 small frequency tiles labeled exactly “E7”, “94”, and “B5”, with the section label in a yellow note reading “2. 频率统计与合并”; beneath and inside the magnified area include a large black Chinese character “电”, and nearby a handwritten note “频繁字节对”. In the third section at lower middle-left, add a wooden sign and a larger merged translucent blue token tile labeled “Token”, with a small yellow note reading “3. 跨字合并”, large black Chinese text “我们→”, and a caption strip below that says “高频词组合并为 Token”. On the far right, show the final explanatory result with 3 small byte boxes labeled “E7”, “94”, and “B5” above a large black Chinese character “电”, then a note card reading “1. 字节级编码（UTF-8）”, and below that the large black Chinese word “我们”. Connect the sections with curved arrows in pink, blue, and green to show process flow. Include 1 animated blue token mascot with tiny arms and legs near the center-bottom, smiling and waving. Use soft cream, pink, beige, and light blue colors, thick clean outlines, sticker-like cutout shapes, taped paper corners, notebook textures, pencils around the edges, and a friendly hand-account illustration style suitable for a science explainer graphic.

items.title: Chinese Cooking Cognition Infographic
items.titleZh: A vintage hand-drawn Chinese infographic on textured off-white paper with torn deckled edges, printed in a limited two-ink palette of deep purple and bright cyan accents, with halftone shading and poster-like comic line art. The composition compares intuitive manual cooking versus tool-assisted cooking and externalized cognition. On the left, a large adult cook in an apron is dramatically stir-frying in a wok with flames, flying ingredients, smoke swirls, and energetic motion lines; the cook’s face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. Above the head is a glowing brain-like thought bubble containing 3 small icons: a seasoning bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, with rays radiating outward. At the lower left, a broken chain hangs beside large bold Chinese text reading “全凭手感”. Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. Beneath it, a hand holds a smartphone recipe screen showing visible Chinese text including “5克盐” and “中火3分钟”, with a finger tapping the screen. Around the phone are measured cooking tools and ingredients: 2 measuring spoons, 1 measuring cup, 1 digital scale, and 6 small bowls arranged neatly, plus a pot on a stove with steam rising and a finished plated dish nearby. Near the plated dish is Chinese text “七八分” and a 5-star rating row with exactly 4 filled stars and 1 empty star. On the right, show a concept map of externalized cognition around a simple smiling stick-figure cook standing behind a table of food. The node network is connected with cyan lines and includes exactly 6 tool/info nodes: a smart oven at the top, 2 seasoning packets labeled “调料包” and “榨酱包”, 1 clipboard labeled “精准配方”, 1 blender, 1 rice cooker, and 1 recipe note sheet. Centered in this network is large Chinese text “认知外化”. The table in front of the figure holds exactly 5 dishes/bowls/plates of prepared food. Along the bottom is a simplified cognition equation: a large brain icon, then an arrow to a smaller brain icon, then a cluster of external tools/documents including a phone screen, a microwave-like appliance, and 3 paper/manual items, then an equals sign, then a muscular human silhouette with gears inside the torso and an upward arrow near the shoulder. Beneath or beside this equation is bold Chinese text “脑 + 外部工具 = 更强能力”, with the first “脑” also shown separately under the left brain icon. Use expressive sketched arrows, doodle lightning bolts, comic emphasis marks, and a balanced left-to-right flow that visually communicates the transition from pure instinct to repeatable systems and augmented ability.

items.title: Cyberpunk Girl with Giant Mech Claw
items.titleZh: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a small eerie girl standing in a narrow rain-soaked alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her oversized mechanical arm dominate the foreground. She wears a large white hooded coat covered with printed patch-like symbols, diagrams, and industrial markings, the hood casting deep shadow over her face. Her face is minimal and doll-like with short straight black hair, pale skin, and two glowing white eyes with no visible pupils, giving a quiet emotionless expression. One of her arms is replaced by an enormous heavy mech limb that is far larger than her body, extending toward the viewer. The arm is built from layered white armored plates, exposed joints, cables, bolts, pistons, and segmented machinery, with scratches and grime for a worn combat-industrial look. The hand has exactly 4 massive clawed fingers touching the wet ground, each ending in long black-red talons, with red internal lights glowing through vents and gaps across the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Add dangling black cables beneath the upper arm and subtle red light leaks around the elbow and shoulder mechanisms. Her other sleeve hangs normally at her side. She wears dark shorts or a skirt beneath the coat and oversized fluffy white leg warmers around her lower legs, with bare feet visible on the reflective pavement. The alley is dense with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signage, including teal-green vertical neon signs in the background, creating a moody cyan backlight. Rain falls through the scene, puddles reflect teal and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scatter near the claw tips on the ground. Use a muted palette of dirty white, charcoal, teal, and crimson, with cinematic contrast, highly detailed linework, gritty textures, atmospheric fog, and a haunting futuristic dystopian mood. Make the character {argument name="character name" default="a hooded mech-arm girl"}, with {argument name="coat color" default="dirty white"} outerwear, {argument name="glow color" default="crimson red"} mechanical lights, and {argument name="neon color" default="teal green"} alley signage.
items.promptZh: 一幅黑暗的赛博朋克动画插图，描绘了一个怪异的小女孩在夜间站在一条被雨水浸湿的狭窄小巷中，从戏剧性的低角度观看，使她的超大机械臂占据了前景。她穿着一件宽大的白色连帽外套，上面印有补丁状的符号、图表和工业标记，连帽在她的脸上投下深深的阴影。她的脸很小，像娃娃一样，黑色的短直发，苍白的皮肤，两只发光的白色眼睛没有可见的瞳孔，表情安静而没有感情。她的一只手臂被一根比她的身体大得多的巨大重型机械肢体所取代，并向观众延伸。该手臂由分层的白色装甲板、裸露的接头、电缆、螺栓、活塞和分段机械制成，上面有划痕和污垢，呈现出磨损的战斗工业外观。这只手正好有 4 个巨大的爪状手指接触潮湿的地面，每个手指末端都有长长的黑红色爪子，红色的内部灯光通过指关节、手腕和前臂上的通风口和间隙发出光芒。在上臂下方添加悬挂的黑色电缆，并在肘部和肩部机构周围添加微妙的红光泄漏。她的另一只袖子通常挂在身边。她在外套下面穿着深色短裤或裙子，小腿周围有超大的蓬松白色暖腿套，光脚在反光的人行道上清晰可见。巷子里密布着管道、导管、电缆、通风口和旧标牌，包括背景中的青绿色垂直霓虹灯标志，营造出喜怒无常的青色背光。雨水穿过场景，水坑反射出青色和红色的光芒，爪尖附近散布着微小的橙红色火花。使用肮脏的白色、木炭色、青色和深红色的柔和调色板，具有电影对比度、高度细致的线条、坚韧的纹理、大气雾气和令人难以忘怀的未来反乌托邦情绪。制作角色{argument name="character name" default="a hooded mech-arm girls"}，穿上{argument name="coat color" default="dirty White"}外套、{argument name="glow color" default="crimson red"}机械灯和{argument name="neon color" default="teal green"}小巷标牌。

items.title: Satirical Expensive Supplements Cartoon
items.titleZh: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Next to it, place a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. Use a humorous, critical, social-media infographic tone, balanced composition, crisp typography, high readability, and polished modern vector illustration aesthetics.

Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Next to it, place a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. items.title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt
items.titleZh:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

From left to right: Immature → Mature → Overripe → Spoiled

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.
items.prompt:
以“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面中必须是“一个完整的单体食物”（如一个土豆 / 一把香蕉 / 一头大蒜），
通过横向切片的方式，表现同一个食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而不是多个不同食物拼接。

食物主体保持结构连续、形状一致，只是在不同切片区域呈现不同成熟度（像时间被切开）。

画面为竖版3:4比例，主体居中横向展开，被均匀分割为4-6段：

从左到右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每一段体现真实变化：

颜色变化（青→黄→黑等）
质地变化（饱满→软化→皱缩→腐坏）
特征变化（发芽、出水、霉变等）

每个阶段配文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特点
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高真实感摄影风格
清晰分割线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用⚠️✔️等标识

画面顶部标题：“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”

关键要求：必须表现为“同一个食物随时间变化的切片”，而不是多个独立个体拼接

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.titleZh: Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical ratio. The card has a clear theme, the background is beige or off-white with paper texture, and the overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic. At the top of the card, a large red and black contrasting brush cursive font highlights the title to attract the visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each expressing core points with short and refined Chinese phrases. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive script, which is both clear and readable and full of artistic atmosphere. Simple and interesting hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, are dotted on the card to enhance visual appeal and trigger readers' thinking and resonance. Pay attention to visual balance in the overall layout, reserve enough blank space to ensure the image is concise and clear, easy to read and understand. The theme is: "{argument name="theme" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest; stick to setting up your stall every day and keep doing it, there will definitely be results because 99% can't persist."} "
items.prompt: 创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。主题是："{argument name="主题" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}"

items.title: Professional Automotive Technical Infographic Prompt
items.titleZh: Chinese infographic with clear layout, striking large titles, and organized parameter tables, maintaining readability for each module while allowing slight decoration. A 9:16 vertical high-end automotive technical breakdown infographic themed "{argument name="theme" default="Mazda Skyactiv Full Technical Analysis"}", with a black-gray dark background, strong tech feel, and professional car magazine cover-level visuals. In the center is a high-detail 3D perspective breakdown of a {argument name="car model" default="Mazda CX-5"} in Soul Red, showing engines, chassis, suspension, brakes, transmission, and interior in layers. Above is a bold title "{argument name="main title" default="Mazda Skyactiv: Most Detailed Breakdown"}" with brand elements. The layout features various Chinese description modules and parameter cards covering performance, power systems, and safety. The vehicle rendering is photographic-grade with extreme detail in mechanical parts. The style resembles automotive engineering posters or professional promotional infographics, high information density, 8K ultra-sharp, sharp and professional with cinematic lighting.
items.prompt:
中文信息图排版清晰，标题大字醒目，参数表格规整，尽量保持每个中文模块可读，但允许轻微装饰化。一张竖版 9:16 的高端汽车技术拆解信息图，主题为“{argument name="主题" default="马自达创驰蓝天 全面技术解析"}”，整体为黑灰深色背景，科技感强，专业汽车杂志封面级视觉。画面中心是一辆 {argument name="车型" default="马自达CX-5"} 魂动红颜色车身的高精细 3D 透视拆解车，前机舱、车身结构、底盘、悬挂、刹车、变速箱、内饰等多个系统分层展示，车身局部半透明或剖视效果，机械结构清晰可见，金属质感强，细节极其丰富。
上方有醒目的大标题“{argument name="主标题" default="马自达 创驰蓝天 最详细拆解介绍"}”，配合马自达品牌科技感元素。画面四周排布大量中文说明模块与参数卡片，包含“基本参数、性能数据、动力系统、底盘悬挂系统、制动系统、车身结构与安全、空气动力学设计、内饰与科技配置、版本对比、总结”等栏目，整体采用信息图布局，条理清晰，排版紧凑但高级。
中间主体车辆采用真实摄影级渲染，车漆为魂动红颜色，车轮、刹车盘、卡钳、悬挂连杆、发动机、变速箱、碳纤维部件、座舱细节都极度真实。左侧与右侧用细线引导标注部件名称，底部有底盘与内饰局部放大图。整体风格像汽车工程拆解海报、工业设计图、科普宣传长图，画面信息密度高，层次分明，画质超清，8K，超精细，锐利，专业，震撼，电影级灯光，真实金属反光，UI 排版美观，中文字体清晰，现代科技风。

items.title: Restaurant Logo Guidelines Board
items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image as the brand inspiration, transform the fried chicken burger and waffle fries meal into a polished one-page logo guidelines board for a restaurant brand named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Create a cheerful, modern fast-casual identity derived from the food in the reference: turn the crispy fried topping into a playful mascot/icon above the wordmark, and build a bold custom logo in a warm palette inspired by the photo. Design the output as a clean editorial brand sheet on an off-white background with navy and red typography, yellow scalloped borders at the top and bottom, and small sparkle doodles. Include these exact sections and counts: 1 main header reading "LOGO GUIDELINES" with the brand name beneath it; 1 "PRIMARY LOGO" section with the main logo and an "ABOUT THE LOGO" text block; 1 "LOGO VARIANTS" section with 3 variants labeled "FULL COLOR", "SINGLE COLOR", and "REVERSED"; 1 "COLOR VARIATIONS" section with 4 tiles labeled "YELLOW BACKGROUND", "NAVY BACKGROUND", "PINK BACKGROUND", and "NAVY ON CREAM"; 1 "MINIMUM SIZE" section showing the logo with a width guide and the text "1.25 in / 120 px MINIMUM WIDTH"; 1 "CLEAR SPACE" section with a spacing diagram based on the height of the letter C; 1 "INCORRECT USAGE" section with 4 wrong examples labeled "Don't change the colors", "Don't stretch or distort", "Don't rotate the logo", and "Don't add effects or shadows"; 1 "USAGE NOTES" section with 4 bullet points; and a handwritten-style closing tagline at bottom right that says {argument name="tagline text" default="It's a vibe. It's a smile. It's yours."}. Keep the composition crisp, print-ready, highly legible, and presentation-quality, like a real branding deliverable for a restaurant.

Vintage botanical-style infographic for “{argument name="product" default="Artisan Brew Coffee Beans"}.” 19th-century lithograph look, aged parchment tones (brown, beige, muted green). Center: steaming coffee cup + labeled bag, elegant title “{argument name="title" default="Premium Coffee Craft"}.” Surrounding small illustrations: beans, plant, grinder, kettle, cup. Simple process grid: harvest → dry → roast → grind → brew → pour. Scenic coffee farm footer. Fine ink lines, soft watercolor, rustic, artisanal feel.

items.title: Futuristic Ice Skincare Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-end futuristic skincare advertisement poster in icy blue and white tones, vertical 2:3 composition. The scene features a translucent glass female bust in left profile with a low bun hairstyle, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame. Inside the transparent head, neck, and torso is a surreal miniature landscape of blue cliffs, glowing water, and multiple waterfalls, like a frozen digital sanctuary contained within the body. Add tiny suspended bubbles, glossy reflections, misty atmosphere, and soft aurora-like light streaks drifting diagonally across the image. On the right side, place a clean white cylindrical skincare bottle standing upright on a jagged translucent ice pedestal. The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} and below it {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, with smaller technical cosmetic copy beneath in a minimal editorial layout. Set giant vertical glowing text along the far right edge reading {argument name="side headline" default="DEEP CORE PURITY"}. Add 4 small infographic-style callouts in a sleek tech-beauty design: a top-right droplet icon with the heading “MOISTURE LOCK” and two short lines of tiny supporting text, a mid-right shield icon with the heading “IP PROTECTION” and three short lines of tiny supporting text, a lower-left headline block reading “PURE CONNECTION PURE CONFIDENCE” with 2 short lines of body copy, and a far-left small label reading “DATA STREAM PURIFIER” with a bracket line pointing toward the glass figure. Include a centered solid pale blue rectangular overlay covering part of the face and upper torso, as a flat opaque block. Lighting is ethereal, glossy, and premium, with strong bloom, frosted highlights, soft backlight, and luxury sci-fi cosmetic campaign styling. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic 3D render, clean commercial poster design, minimal yet surreal, polished surfaces, cold luminous atmosphere.

Each card includes: a realistic photo of the vegetable, the English name (bold), British or American phonetic notation (IPA), and a brief English description. Overall style: minimalist design, white background, soft green and light color palette, card-based UI with rounded corners, tidy typography, and visual balance. Suitable for English beginners, similar to a classroom teaching poster. Ideal for social media sharing, high resolution, 4K, infographic style. Size: 1080x1350.
items.prompt:
一张干净的英语学习信息图海报，标题为“{argument name="标题" default="20种常见蔬菜"}”，
采用整齐的网格布局（4x5），每个卡片展示一种蔬菜。

每个卡片包含：

- 英文名称（加粗）

- 简短英文描述

极简设计，白色背景，柔和的绿色和浅色系配色，
卡片式UI设计，圆角边框，排版整齐，视觉平衡，
适合英语初学者学习，类似课堂教学海报

适合社交媒体传播，高分辨率，4K，信息图风格

尺寸：1080×1350

items.title: Sci-Fi Mech Blueprint Hangar
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-detailed sci-fi mech hangar interior at night, shown in a wide-angle view from slightly above a massive horizontal holographic planning table. The glowing blue tabletop dominates the foreground and center, displaying an intricate engineering blueprint for a humanoid combat robot labeled {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}. The blueprint includes exactly 3 large full-body orthographic mech drawings across the table, one front view, one side view, and one rear view, plus many smaller component diagrams for hands, joints, feet, armor segments, and circular mechanical parts, dense technical callouts, graphs, measurement lines, and blocks of Japanese annotation text mixed with alphanumeric labels. Around the table are exactly 5 engineers in light gray industrial jumpsuits studying the design, leaning over the edges and holding rugged tablets; their faces are intentionally indistinct and partially obscured. In the deep background, exactly 1 towering real humanoid mech stands upright in a maintenance gantry, suspended or docked in a cavernous factory bay filled with catwalks, scaffolding, pipes, heavy cables hanging from the ceiling, illuminated control panels, glass partitions, and a few tiny distant workers for scale. Use a cold steel-and-cyan color palette, dramatic volumetric lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, subtle mist, high contrast shadows, and a serious military-industrial mood. The environment should feel dense, realistic, and operational, like a secret advanced robotics facility. Emphasize scale, technical complexity, and the contrast between the flat luminous blueprint and the massive constructed mech behind it. Render in photorealistic concept-art style with crisp linework on the holographic display, cinematic depth, and extreme detail.
items.promptZh: 夜间电影般的超详细科幻机甲机库内部，从巨大的水平全息规划台上方以广角视图显示。发光的蓝色桌面占据了前景和中心，展示了一个人形战斗机器人的复杂工程蓝图，标记为{argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}。该蓝图包括桌子上的 3 张大型全身正交机械图、一张前视图、一张侧视图和一张后视图，以及许多较小的手部、关节、脚、装甲部分和圆形机械零件的组件图、密集的技术标注、图表、测量线以及与字母数字标签混合的日语注释文本块。桌子周围正好有 5 位穿着浅灰色工业连身服的工程师，他们靠在桌子边缘，拿着坚固的平板电脑，研究设计。他们的脸被故意模糊并部分遮挡。在深处的背景中，恰好有一台高耸的真实人形机甲直立在维护龙门上，悬挂或停靠在一个巨大的工厂车间里，里面充满了走道、脚手架、管道、从天花板垂下来的重型电缆、发光的控制面板、玻璃隔板，以及一些远处的微小工人。使用冷钢和青色调色板、引人注目的体积照明、反光金属表面、微妙的雾气、高对比度阴影和严肃的军工氛围。环境应该让人感觉密集、真实且可操作，就像一个秘密的先进机器人设施。强调规模、技术复杂性以及平面发光蓝图与其背后庞大的机械结构之间的对比。以逼真的概念艺术风格进行渲染，在全息显示上呈现清晰的线条、电影般的深度和极致的细节。

items.title: Countryball Hormuz Strait Standoff
items.titleZh: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {argument name="left country" default="United States"} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {argument name="right country" default="Iran"} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. At the top right, include a large Iranian flag overlay along the coastline. Draw beige landmasses around the waterway to resemble a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. At the bottom center, add a bold caption in Korean and English on the sand: {argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}. The mood should be satirical, tense, and meme-like, but visually cute and readable.
items.promptZh: 幽默的政治模因插图，采用简单的乡村球卡通风格，展示了作为狭窄咽喉要道的{argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"}的现状。使用宽阔的风景构图，具有明亮的平面色彩、粗的黑色轮廓和干净的手绘信息图表式外观。在前景中，将两个乡村球并肩站立在一座极其狭窄的沙质陆桥上，两侧都有岩石，显然一次只能有一个人通过。左边是一个涂有美国国旗的{argument name="leftcountry"default="United States"}国家球，戴着黑色墨镜和棕色牛仔帽，以顽固的态度面对对方的球。右边是一个涂有伊朗国旗的{argument name="right Country" default="Iran"}国家球，戴着一顶深色头巾般的帽子，愤怒的斜眼，也拒绝移动。添加 2 个大的白色气泡，每个国家球旁边都有一个，然后在两个气泡中放入相同的粗体韩语单词：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}。中景和背景中，一片繁忙的蓝色大海上挤满了总共9艘船只：最左边有2艘灰色的美国军舰，1艘悬挂着红色中国国旗的中国潜艇，4艘油轮排列在中左和中间，悬挂着不同的国旗，狭窄的通道附近有2艘灰色的军舰，悬挂着小美国国旗。在右上角，沿着海岸线覆盖了一面巨大的伊朗国旗。在水道周围绘制米色陆地，类似于霍尔木兹海峡的简化地图视图。在底部中心，在沙子上添加韩语和英语的粗体标题：{argument name="bottom Caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}。情绪应该是讽刺的、紧张的、模因式的，但视觉上可爱且可读。

items.title: Thoughtful Systems Presentation Cover
items.titleZh: Create a refined editorial presentation cover slide in a warm, Claude-inspired design system. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with a parchment-paper background, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, and layered torn-paper collage elements. The overall palette should be warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal, muted black, and terracotta accent. On the left half, place a small top label reading "{argument name="system label" default="Claude-inspired presentation system"}" with a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal divider line. Below it, set an oversized elegant high-contrast serif headline in black that reads "{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}", split across two lines and dominating the left side. Under the headline, add a smaller serif subheadline in terracotta reading "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still feel precise."}". Beneath that, create a vertical list of exactly 4 design principles, each on its own row with thin divider lines and a small icon at left: 1) a rectangular parchment-sheet icon with the text "Parchment canvas", 2) a serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-led hierarchy", 3) a filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for signal", 4) a chain-link icon with the text "Organic diagrams over cold chrome". Add a tiny footer caption at bottom left reading "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in spaced small caps. On the right half, build a layered collage of exactly 3 paper cards: first, a tall off-white art card with a fine border containing the heading "A more considered approach", a short body paragraph about complex problems yielding to clarity, a minimal landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta botanical branch overlapping the card; second, a dark charcoal rectangular card partially behind it with the lowercase title "thinking process" and an exact 5-step numbered list: "01 Observe", "02 Interpret", "03 Connect", "04 Synthesize", "05 Act with care", plus a delicate circular orbital diagram in dotted lines and terracotta highlight; third, a torn off-white note card in front near the bottom with a hand-drawn overlapping-circles diagram where one crescent-shaped intersection area is shaded in terracotta, alongside a handwritten quote reading "{argument name="quote" default="Clarity emerges when systems are designed with intention."}". Include one extra light beige paper strip tucked beneath the lower cards. Emphasize tactile realism, elegant negative space, print-editorial sophistication, soft natural lighting, and a calm, thoughtful luxury-tech mood.
items.promptZh: 在受克劳德启发的温暖设计系统中创建精致的编辑演示文稿封面幻灯片。使用具有羊皮纸背景、微妙的纸纹、柔和的阴影和分层的撕纸拼贴元素的风景 16:9 构图。整体色调应该是温暖的象牙色、奶油色、沙色、木炭色、柔和的黑色和赤土色。在左半部分，放置一个小顶部标签，上面写着“{argument name =“system label”default =“Claude-inspiredpresentation system”}”，带有一个小陶土点和一条细水平分隔线。在其下方，设置一个超大的、优雅的、高对比度的黑色衬线标题，上面写着“{argument name="main header" default="Thoughtful Systems"}”，分成两行并占据左侧。在标题下，添加一个较小的赤土色衬线副标题，内容为“{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still Feel Precision."}”。在其下方，创建一个包含 4 个设计原则的垂直列表，每个设计原则在其自己的行上，带有细分隔线，并在左侧有一个小图标：1）一个矩形羊皮纸图标，上面写着“羊皮纸画布”，2）一个衬线大写 T 图标，上面写着“衬线主导的层次结构”，3）一个填充的赤土圆形图标，上面写着“赤土信号”，4）一个链式图标，上面写着“冷的有机图”铬”。在左下角添加一个小页脚标题，用间隔小写大写字母写着“CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM”。在右半部分，用 3 张纸卡制作分层拼贴画：首先，一张高大的灰白色艺术卡，带有细边框，其中包含标题“更经过深思熟虑的方法”，一段关于复杂问题的简短正文段落，清晰可见，带有赤土太阳的最小风景线图，以及与卡重叠的垂直赤土植物分支；第二，一张深色木炭矩形卡片，部分在其后面，上面写着小写标题“思考过程”和一个精确的 5 步编号列表：“01 观察”、“02 解释”、“03 连接”、“04 综合”、“05 小心行事”，以及精致的虚线圆形轨道图和赤土色突出显示；第三，前面靠近底部的一张撕破的灰白色便条卡，上面有一张手绘的重叠圆圈图，其中一个新月形交叉区域用赤土色遮蔽，旁边有一条手写引文，上面写着“{argument name =“quote”default =“当系统有意设计时，清晰度就会出现。”}”。在下面的卡片下方添加一条额外的浅米色纸条。强调触觉真实感、优雅的负空间、精致的印刷编辑、柔和的自然光线以及平静、深思熟虑的奢华科技氛围。

items.titleZh: Create a clean premium Japanese tech infographic poster for {argument name="product name" default="Meta Quest 3"}, centered on a vertically stacked exploded view of a white mixed-reality headset floating in space against a soft lavender-to-blue gradient background. At the top, place the Meta logo in blue followed by a large bold black sans-serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="Meta Quest 3"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline beneath: 「まったく新しい現実を、まったく新しい構造から。」. The central subject is a highly polished 3D product render shown as an engineering breakdown with exactly 9 numbered layers, each layer separated evenly from top to bottom and labeled with blue circular number markers on the left side from 1 to 9. The 9 visible layers are: 1) the white outer faceplate shell with three front sensor/camera openings, 2) a row of exactly 3 black tracking camera modules, 3) the main logic board with chips and a clearly visible Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 processor graphic at the center, 4) a pair of large pancake lens assemblies with vivid purple-blue glass reflections, 5) the black internal frame chassis with openings for optics, 6) the battery/electronics bar with glowing blue accents, 7) two white articulated side strap arms, 8) a white fabric head strap loop, 9) a black soft facial interface cushion at the bottom. Add rounded rectangular annotation boxes with thin white borders and subtle transparency on both sides, each connected by fine white leader lines to the corresponding layer. There are exactly 7 feature callout boxes total: 3 on the left and 4 on the right. Left side boxes, from top to bottom, read: 「Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2」 with a chip icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「調整可能なIPD機構」 with an optics adjustment icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「精密設計されたヘッドストラップ」 with a headset strap icon and smaller Japanese body text. Right side boxes, from top to bottom, read: 「フェイスプレート」 with a simple faceplate icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「トラッキングカメラ」 with a camera icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「パンケーキレンズ」 with a dual-lens icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「高性能バッテリー」 with a battery icon and smaller Japanese body text, plus a lower-right box reading 「柔らかなフェイスインターフェース」 with a soft cushion icon and smaller Japanese body text; keep the overall visual balance elegant and symmetric. At the bottom, add a wide white rounded banner spanning most of the width. On its left side place a large bold Japanese statement in blue: 「体験は、構造から進化する。」 and below it smaller Japanese explanatory copy in black. On the right side of the banner place the blue Meta logo and the wordmark “Meta”. Use a sleek Apple-like product marketing style, ultra-sharp 3D rendering, soft studio lighting, subtle glow, precise shadows, glossy plastics, realistic materials, minimal clutter, and a high-end corporate presentation aesthetic.

items.title: Vintage Beijing Travel Scrapbook Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster about {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, designed as a Chinese-language illustrated tourist guide page on warm aged paper lying on a wooden tabletop. The composition is a single vertical poster with a slightly worn notebook-page look, soft stains, folded corners, tape marks, stamp-like ink smudges, and a casual collage aesthetic. At the top center, place large bold black Chinese calligraphy for {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, with the English word {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} underneath in loose blue brush script. Near the title, add a small red seal stamp and a short Chinese text block on the upper right describing the geographic location of the city in dark blue handwritten-style Chinese characters.

Below the title, include 4 taped polaroid-style travel photos arranged in a slightly uneven row, each with a handwritten English caption on the white border. Photo 1: the Forbidden City at sunset with golden reflections and warm orange light, captioned about warm golden tones. Photo 2: the Great Wall winding across green mountains under a bright sky, captioned about Great Wall of China landscape and green mountains. Photo 3: Beihai Park lake with willow branches, boats, and a white stupa in the background, captioned about a serene lake view. Photo 4: a traditional hutong alley with gray brick walls and hanging red lanterns, captioned about red lanterns and a charming narrow street. Use different decorative tape patterns above the photos.

Arrange the lower two-thirds like an illustrated infographic with colorful doodles and handwritten Chinese headings in red and blue. Include 5 main content sections: a geographic description block at the top right; a “best travel season” section on the left with Chinese text recommending spring and autumn, decorated with a leaf doodle and a small sun icon; a “main attractions and features” section on the left-middle listing exactly 3 items in Chinese with bullet points: Forbidden City, Badaling Great Wall, and Shichahai & hutongs, accompanied by line-art sketches of a palace pavilion, the Great Wall, hutong houses, and a small tricycle; a “must-eat foods” section on the lower left listing exactly 3 foods in Chinese with bullet points: Peking duck, zhajiangmian, and douzhi, alongside cute food illustrations of a roast duck platter, a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, and a surprised face doodle; and a “tips” section near the lower middle with exactly 2 advice lines in Chinese, each with a small icon, one about wearing comfortable shoes because attractions are large, and one about booking tickets in advance because holidays are crowded.

Add a small outline map of China near the center-right with Beijing marked by a red star and a curved arrow pointing to it. Place a traditional stone guardian lion illustration on the right side with a comic-style handwritten Chinese callout bubble saying it is super imposing. Add a highlighted recommendation box with a scalloped red outline containing exactly 2 recommended places in Chinese: Temple of Heaven Park with a note about praying for good harvests, and Nanluoguxiang; decorate this box with 2 architectural illustrations, one of the Temple of Heaven and one of a traditional gate building. At the very bottom, include a bold handwritten Chinese quote line in dark blue with red emphasis marks, plus 3 doodles beside it: a retro camera, the Bird’s Nest stadium with a small red heart, and the CCTV Headquarters building.

Overall style: cozy travel journal infographic, hand-drawn pen-and-watercolor look, slightly naive sketch style, scrapbook collage, cream paper texture, muted red and navy blue palette with soft greens and warm browns, playful but informative layout, highly legible mixed typography, clean composition, nostalgic tourism poster feel.

The design is a single vertically stacked poster with 4 clearly separated sections and all text rendered sharply in Korean and English calligraphy. At the top, place a large ribbon banner with bold black Korean brush lettering reading "정통 한국 김밥" and a smaller ribbon subtitle reading "Traditional Korean Gimbap". items.titleZh:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI researcher, Chen Boyuan"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "God! It learned to 'catch' again!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese "we are working hard to fix it!"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps."

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on Chen Boyuan's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small "Ultra-small Chinese is also clearly readable:" with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with "(This is an ultra-small font size test) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese is finally fixed. Haven't been home for many years, really want to eat hairy crabs!" (ultra small).

items.titleZh: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. These are just examples, I need you to actively think about other elements / styles that may fit in a good design that's not limited to these concepts. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.titleZh:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name="theme content" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest. Keep setting up your stall every day, keep doing it, and there will definitely be results, because 99% of people can't stick to it."}"
items.prompt:
创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。

卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。

卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。

主题是：“{argument name="主题内容" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}”

items.title: Minimal Pelican Riding Bicycle
items.titleZh: A minimalist vector-style illustration on a flat light gray background showing a pelican riding a bicycle, drawn from simple geometric shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image and the bird’s head floating slightly above and forward of the handlebars in a deliberately abstract, diagram-like way. The bicycle is a simple black road-bike silhouette in side view with exactly 2 large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and exactly 4 visible spoke lines forming a cross, a straight horizontal ground line beneath both wheels, a triangular frame, a short black saddle, and simplified crank and pedal details near the rear of the frame. The pelican is constructed from clean abstract pieces: a white rounded head with a small black circular eye, a long open beak pointing left made of 2 parts with an upper orange triangular section and a lower pale pink pouch section, a short dark curve on top of the head, a small separate white oval neck/body connector, a larger white rounded body positioned over the bike, and a single white wing-like shape angled upward over the back. Add exactly 2 orange leg shapes, long narrow rectangles leaning downward from the body toward the bicycle frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Keep the forms intentionally sparse and slightly surreal, like a logo test or simple code-editor doodle, with no shading, no gradients, no textures, no text, and lots of negative space.

items.title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid
items.titleZh:
Create a square infographic-style illustration showing a {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} invention timeline grid rendered as a collection of miniature isometric dioramas on aged parchment tiles. The image should look like a curated historical poster that spans from {argument name="starting year" default="1000 BC"} to {argument name="ending year" default="2026"}, with one invention per tile and no repeats. Show the visible portion as a 5 by 5 section of the larger grid, for a total of 25 labeled tiles, arranged in neat rows and columns with thin dark borders. Every tile contains a unique world-changing invention depicted as a small handcrafted diorama with era-appropriate materials, colors, and background details. Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) {argument name="first tile label" default="1000 BC"} tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; 8) "Windmill" shown as a traditional mill on grassy ground; 9) "Gunpowder" shown as a barrel and a mound of black powder with smoke; 10) "Printing Press" shown as a wooden press framed by classical columns; 11) "Mechanical Clock" shown as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope" shown as an early brass telescope on a tripod with sketch-like scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine" shown on a blue blueprint-style tile with an early locomotive engine; 14) "Electric Battery" shown on a blueprint-like tile with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 15) "Telegraph" shown as a Morse telegraph key on technical paper; 16) "Light Bulb" shown glowing warmly on a neutral pedestal; 17) "Automobile" shown as an early red motorcar on a workshop-plan background; 18) "Airplane" shown as a commercial jet aircraft in miniature; 19) "Transistor" shown as a black microchip on a luminous circuit-board tile; 20) "Personal Computer" shown as a beige desktop computer with CRT monitor and keyboard; 21) "World Wide Web" shown as a glowing blue globe over digital circuitry; 22) "Smartphone" shown as a sleek modern phone on a neon-tech background; 23) "CRISPR-Cas9" shown as a DNA double helix in a biotech-blue display tile; 24) "Reusable Rocket" shown as several upright rockets launching with exhaust clouds; 25) "AI (LLMs)" shown as glowing large letters AI in a holographic tech cube; 26) "Brain-Computer Interface" shown as a glowing brain hologram on a blue platform; 27) "Advanced Neural Interface (Implant)" shown as a transparent human head profile with a glowing brain implant, with a small top label reading "2026".

Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. Use slight isometric perspective, crisp linework, painterly shading, and polished editorial illustration quality. The overall feeling should combine museum poster, educational timeline, and imaginative historical-tech diorama art.

创建一个方形信息图表风格的插图，显示一个{argument name="grid size" default="15×15"}发明时间线网格，该网格呈现为老化羊皮纸瓷砖上的微型等距立体模型的集合。该图片应看起来像一张精选的历史海报，范围从 {argument name="starting Year" default="1000 BC"} 到 {argument name="ending Year" default="2026"}，每个图块有一个发明，没有重复。将可见部分显示为较大网格的 5 x 5 部分，总共 25 个带标签的图块，排列成整齐的行和列，并带有细暗边框。每块瓷砖都包含一个独特的改变世界的发明，被描绘成一个小型手工制作的立体模型，具有适合时代的材料、颜色和背景细节。对古代和中世纪的发明使用温暖的古色古香的调色板，对早期现代发明使用深褐色的技术文档色调，对现代数字和生物技术发明使用较冷的霓虹蓝色未来主义照明。用旧地图边框和微妙的历史制图纹理包围网格，融入右下角附近微弱的现代网络图形。

用粗体黑色文本的米色小标题标签标记每个可见的图块。按照从左上到右下的阅读顺序，准确地包括这 25 项可见发明： 1) {argument name="firsttile label"default="1000 BC"} 瓷砖显示农田中的铁犁和简单的手动工具，标题为“铁犁和工具”； 2）“零的概念”显示为羊皮纸状的瓷砖，刻有零符号和蓝色沙漏； 3）“水钟”，表现为木制的流水计时装置； 4）“Catapult”显示为木制攻城器械； 5）“安提凯西拉机构”在石壁龛中展示为一个复杂的青铜齿轮装置； 6）“混凝土”显示为装满湿水泥或砂浆的独轮车； 7）“独轮车”，表现为一辆简单的木制独轮车； 8）“风车”展示为草地上的传统磨坊； 9）“火药”显示为一个桶和一堆冒着烟雾的黑色火药； 10）“印刷机”，展示为由古典柱框框的木制印刷机； 11) “机械时钟”显示为华丽的立式时钟； 12）“望远镜”，显示为三脚架上的早期黄铜望远镜，带有草图般的科学注释； 13）蓝色蓝图式瓷砖上显示的“蒸汽机”，带有早期机车发动机； 14）“电池”显示在类似蓝图的图块上，带有两个圆柱形电池和接线； 15) “电报”在技术论文中显示为莫尔斯电报键； 16）“灯泡”在中性基座上发出温暖的光； 17）“汽车”在车间平面图背景上显示为早期的红色汽车； 18）“飞机”，显示为微型商用喷气式飞机； 19) “晶体管”显示为发光电路板块上的黑色微芯片； 20) “个人电脑”显示为带有 CRT 显示器和键盘的米色台式电脑； 21）“万维网”在数字电路上显示为发光的蓝色地球仪； 22）“智能手机”在霓虹科技背景下显示为时尚的现代手机； 23) “CRISPR-Cas9”在生物技术蓝色显示块中显示为 DNA 双螺旋； 24）“可重复使用火箭”，显示为几枚直立火箭，带着废气云发射； 25）“AI（法学硕士）”在全息科技立方体中显示为发光的大字母AI； 26）“脑机接口”在蓝色平台上显示为发光的大脑全息图； 27) “高级神经接口（植入物）”显示为透明的人体头部轮廓，带有发光的大脑植入物，顶部有一个小标签，上面写着“2026”。

保持构图高度组织化、海报式且视觉密集，每个图块都一目了然。使用轻微的等距透视、清晰的线条、绘画般的阴影和精美的编辑插图质量。整体感觉应该结合博物馆海报、教育时间表和富有想象力的历史科技立体模型艺术。

items.titleZh: A richly layered maximalist collage poster in portrait orientation, designed as a celebration of art, science, history, and human creativity. At the exact center, place a large irregular black ink-splatter or torn-paper void with radiant multicolored streaks around it, containing elegant large serif typography reading {argument name="headline text" default="Create Everything at Once"} in warm ivory. Surround the center with a dense scrapbook-style arrangement of exactly 33 visible items overlapping edge to edge like a curated mood board: 1 illuminated medieval manuscript page with ornate floral border in the top left, 1 botanical mushroom study sheet near it, 1 star chart or astronomical diagram page, 1 solar system illustration across the upper top center with planets on orbit lines against deep space, 1 periodic table chart in the upper middle-left, 1 circular night-sky constellation map in the upper middle-right, 1 cluster of blue crystals, 1 alpine mountain landscape painting, 1 geometric mosaic tile fragment in the top right corner, 1 blue-and-white ceramic teapot on the right edge, 1 antique tribal mask on the right-center, 1 torn vertical calligraphy page with multilingual writing, 1 small isometric polyhedron or gemstone drawing, 1 pixel-art rocket icon card, 1 multicolored wayfinding sign with arrows and transport symbols, 1 black-and-white architectural sketch page along the right side, 1 iridescent feather in the lower-right edge, 1 underwater coral reef photo in the bottom-right corner, 1 purple amethyst cluster, 1 triangular geometric mosaic textile or tile pattern, 1 colorful woven textile swatch, 1 circular carved stone calendar disk, 1 black-and-white city skyline print, 1 botanical flower drawing near the bottom center, 1 stained-glass window illustration, 1 blue architectural blueprint sheet, 1 color wheel chart, 1 abstract blue cell-like or mineral micrograph image, 1 Great Wave-style Japanese seascape print on the lower left, 1 ancient Greek pottery fragment, 1 anatomical human muscle illustration on the left side, 1 butterfly specimen card, and 1 vintage silver camera just left of center. Add a second small botanical flower sketch near the lower-left center and a parchment map fragment tucked behind the camera area as subtle fillers while keeping the total primary featured objects at 33. Blend media styles including engraving, scientific diagrams, vintage prints, fine art painting, photography, textile patterns, blueprints, and digital design UI. Near the bottom left, include 1 dark computer interface panel showing node-based creative software and color grading tools with charts and a circular color selector, suggesting modern AI-assisted creation. Use torn paper edges, aged parchment textures, ink stains, saturated jewel tones, deep blues, golds, creams, and pops of neon cyan, magenta, orange, and violet. items.titleZh: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

items.title: Gritty Evangelion Unit-01 Poster
items.titleZh: A gritty vertical anime-mecha poster in distressed screen-print style, inspired by retro military dossiers and Evangelion key art. The main subject is a massive close-up side profile of {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}, dominating the right two-thirds of the composition, facing left with its jaws open in a feral scream. The head is angular and biomechanical, with deep purple armor, olive-green accent plates, black metal inner structures, a single long horn projecting diagonally upward to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow glowing eye. The surface is scratched, chipped, weathered, and inked with heavy comic-style linework. Behind it is a dark navy blueprint background filled with 8 visible technical diagram clusters, white schematic lines, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A violent red paint slash explodes diagonally across the upper center and left side, with additional red drips running downward from the mecha’s mouth area. In the lower left corner, 1 small human figure sits hunched on a gray equipment crate: a teenage boy in a short-sleeve white school shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, elbows on knees, looking down at a glowing handheld device, conveying isolation and anxiety. Add layered poster typography and warning graphics throughout the border: a torn yellow caution sign in the upper right with Japanese warning text and “CAUTION NERV ONLY”; a tall left sidebar with “01”, barcode-like blocks, hazard icons, and red-black labels; large distressed white kanji vertically stacked over the mecha torso; the word {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} in spaced red capitals beneath the kanji; a small black label reading “PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”; a bottom-right NERV logo; and footer text such as classified file markings and top secret stamps. Include 6 clearly readable English technical labels in the blueprint area: “TEST TYPE”, “BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”, “AT FIELD”, “MAGI SYSTEM”, “INTERNAL”, and “CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”. Add Japanese dossier text blocks as authentic graphic texture. The palette is limited to dark indigo, black, crimson red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn-paper collage details, halftone texture, ink splatter, cracked paint, and worn print edges. Cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collectible poster design, ultra-detailed, sharp, textured, no clean modern polish.

items.title: Xiaomi SU7 Exploded View Chat Screenshot
items.titleZh: A sleek Chinese social-media style screenshot on a dark charcoal black interface, minimalist and premium, with a large rounded rectangular image card placed in the lower left-center and a small rounded chat bubble in the upper right. The overall canvas is mostly empty dark space, giving a clean tech presentation feel. At the top left of the main area, show one line of bold white Chinese text reading: “换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” In the upper right, include a single gray rounded speech bubble with white Chinese text: “小米汽车的产品拆解图”. Below, display one featured poster-like infographic card with rounded corners and a glossy black background. Inside that card, create a highly polished exploded-view automotive product presentation for a turquoise {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} electric sedan, shown in dramatic three-quarter front view, with the car body separated into many components suspended around the chassis. The hood is open, trunk lid lifted, four side doors detached and floating outward, front bumper and fascia separated, headlights isolated, interior exposed, and major mechanical and structural modules arranged neatly in layers beneath and around the body. The visual style should resemble a premium launch-event keynote slide: cinematic studio lighting, realistic reflections, sharp detail, dark background, subtle blue highlights, and precise technical composition. In the upper left of the infographic card, place large white Chinese title text in three lines: “小米汽车 SU7”, “产品拆解图”, “科技跨越，人车合一”. Add an orange square Xiaomi-style logo in the upper right corner of the card. Surround the car with 14 Chinese callout labels connected by thin white leader lines, identifying visible parts and systems. On the left side, include 6 labels for features such as integrated closed front fascia, LED headlights, front trunk design, high-voltage battery, front motor assembly, front double-wishbone suspension, and Brembo four-piston brake caliper. On the right side, include 8 labels for features such as electric tailgate, through-type taillight, frameless doors, hidden door handles, rear motor assembly, rear motor specs, all-aluminum alloy chassis, five-link rear suspension, and Michelin performance tires. Beneath the exploded car body, clearly show the battery pack, front and rear drive units, suspension subframes, wheel assemblies, braking components, front and rear seats, center console parts, underbody panels, and structural floor elements, all separated and floating in a carefully organized exploded arrangement. At the bottom of the infographic card, add a horizontal information strip divided into 5 columns of small Chinese specification text with headings for vehicle dimensions, power performance, range, intelligent driving, and safety structure. In the lower left of the card, place a bold white Chinese label “编辑”. In the lower center, include a circular down-arrow icon, and in the lower right, a share/export icon. The composition should look like a real screenshot from a Chinese AI chat app showcasing an automatically generated high-end car teardown infographic, with modern UI spacing, crisp typography, and a luxurious black-and-cyan color palette.

items.title: Ancient Scholar AI Safety Poster
items.titleZh:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

items.title: Modular Knowledge Encyclopedia Infographic
items.titleZh: Please generate a high-quality vertical 'Science Encyclopedia Infographic' based on the theme: 【{argument name="theme" default="Theme"}】. This should be a modular infographic with a 'handbook, encyclopedia, and structural' feel. Style should combine high-end museum guides, modern encyclopedia pages, and knowledge cards. Include: a clear main visual, close-up feature details, rounded modular info sections, clear heading hierarchy, and concise encyclopedia content. Sections should automatically adapt to the theme, choosing from: basic files, classification, appearance, habits/ecology, mechanism/structure, growth conditions, maintenance, risks, target audience, pros/cons, or rating cards. Visuals: clean light background, soft colors, light shadows, exquisite icons, tidy layout with high density but clear readability. It must look like a publishable knowledge card for collection, not a commercial advertisement.
items.prompt: 请根据【{argument name="主题" default="主题"}】生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。 请让画面包含： - 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉- 若干局部特征放大细节- 多个圆角模块化信息分区- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签- 简洁但丰富的百科内容- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合： 基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。 视觉要求： 浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。 请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理+ 模块信息+ 图鉴式展示”的特征。
